tools.name: save_ride
tools.description: Upsert one of the caller's rides as domain records (ride request plus its driver, vehicle, quote, assignment, trip, trip status event and transition history; trip status only moves forward). Idempotent: ids are derived from the client ride, so replaying the same ride changes nothing.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO riders (id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :__now, :__now)

INSERT INTO drivers (rider_id, id, display_name, rating, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :driver_id, :driver_name, :driver_rating, 'active', :__now, :__now WHERE :driver_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = excluded.display_name, rating = COALESCE(excluded.rating, drivers.rating), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO vehicles (rider_id, id, driver_id, plate, vehicle_class, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :vehicle_id, :driver_id, :vehicle_plate, :vehicle_class, :__now, :__now WHERE :vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = excluded.driver_id, vehicle_class = COALESCE(excluded.vehicle_class, vehicles.vehicle_class), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO ride_requests (rider_id, id, booking_type, status, pickup_label, pickup_lat, pickup_lng, dropoff_label, dropoff_lat, dropoff_lng, recurring_days, pickup_time, scheduled_for, vehicle_class, requested_at, client_record, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :request_id, :booking_type, :request_status, :pickup_label, :pickup_lat, :pickup_lng, :dropoff_label, :dropoff_lat, :dropoff_lng, :recurring_days, :pickup_time, :scheduled_for, :vehicle_class, :requested_at, :client_record, :created_at, :__now) ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET booking_type = excluded.booking_type, status = CASE WHEN excluded.status = 'open' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.rider_id = ride_requests.rider_id AND d.request_id = ride_requests.id AND d.status = 'matched') THEN 'matched' ELSE excluded.status END, pickup_label = excluded.pickup_label, pickup_lat = excluded.pickup_lat, pickup_lng = excluded.pickup_lng, dropoff_label = excluded.dropoff_label, dropoff_lat = excluded.dropoff_lat, dropoff_lng = excluded.dropoff_lng, recurring_days = excluded.recurring_days, pickup_time = excluded.pickup_time, scheduled_for = excluded.scheduled_for, vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, requested_at = excluded.requested_at, client_record = excluded.client_record, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO quotes (rider_id, id, request_id, vehicle_class, fare_cents, eta_minutes, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :quote_id, :request_id, :vehicle_class, :fare_cents, :eta_minutes, 'accepted', :__now, :__now WHERE :quote_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, fare_cents = excluded.fare_cents, eta_minutes = excluded.eta_minutes, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO assignments (rider_id, id, request_id, driver_id, vehicle_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :assignment_id, :request_id, :driver_id, :vehicle_id, 'accepted', :__now, :__now WHERE :assignment_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = excluded.driver_id, vehicle_id = excluded.vehicle_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_transitions (rider_id, id, trip_id, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_event_id, :trip_id, CASE WHEN c.cur = :trip_status THEN NULL ELSE c.cur END, :trip_status, 'rider', :__user_id, '{"source":"save_ride"}', :__now FROM (SELECT (SELECT t.status FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.id = :trip_id) AS cur) c WHERE :trip_event_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.cur IS NULL OR c.cur = :trip_status OR (c.cur IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND CASE :trip_status WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END > CASE c.cur WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END))

INSERT INTO trips (rider_id, id, request_id, assignment_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_id, :request_id, :assignment_id, :trip_status, :__now, :__now WHERE :trip_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET assignment_id = excluded.assignment_id, status = CASE WHEN trips.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND CASE excluded.status WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END > CASE trips.status WHEN 'scheduled' THEN 0 WHEN 'en_route' THEN 1 WHEN 'arrived' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END THEN excluded.status ELSE trips.status END, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, type, status, at) SELECT :__user_id, :trip_event_id, :trip_id, 'status', :trip_status, :__now WHERE :trip_event_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.status = :trip_status)

tools.name: cancel_ride
tools.description: Rider: cancel one of the caller's ride requests. A matched trip is cancelled with a recorded reason (changed_plans, wait_too_long, wrong_pickup, found_other, other) and a fee under the cancellation policy: free before a driver is assigned and within 2 minutes of assignment, 5.00 later (capped at the fare), 8.00 once the driver has arrived. A trip that has started or finished cannot be cancelled by the rider; completed history is never rewritten. Withdraws any dispatch offer. Deletes the trip's live location. Finalizes the immutable fare statement for the trip. Queues in-app and push notifications for the other party. Keeps a coarse position snapshot as dispute evidence for 30 days.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_lifecycle (rider_id, trip_id, updated_at) SELECT t.rider_id, t.id, :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL

UPDATE trip_lifecycle SET outcome = 'rider_cancelled', cancelled_by_role = 'rider', cancel_code = CASE WHEN :reason_code IN ('changed_plans', 'wait_too_long', 'wrong_pickup', 'found_other', 'other') THEN :reason_code ELSE 'other' END, cancel_note = substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), cancel_fee_cents = (SELECT CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' THEN MIN(800, coalesce((SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0)) WHEN :__now - (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) <= 120000 THEN 0 ELSE MIN(500, coalesce((SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0)) END FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = trip_lifecycle.rider_id AND t.id = trip_lifecycle.trip_id), fee_policy = (SELECT CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' THEN 'arrived_cancel' WHEN :__now - (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) <= 120000 THEN 'free_grace' ELSE 'late_cancel' END FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = trip_lifecycle.rider_id AND t.id = trip_lifecycle.trip_id), ended_at = :__now, updated_at = :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = trip_lifecycle.rider_id AND t.id = trip_lifecycle.trip_id AND t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL)

INSERT INTO trip_lifecycle_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, event, actor_id, actor_role, reason_code, note, amount_cents, at) SELECT t.rider_id, :__uuid, t.id, 'cancelled', :__user_id, 'rider', CASE WHEN :reason_code IN ('changed_plans', 'wait_too_long', 'wrong_pickup', 'found_other', 'other') THEN :reason_code ELSE 'other' END, substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' THEN MIN(800, coalesce((SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0)) WHEN :__now - (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) <= 120000 THEN 0 ELSE MIN(500, coalesce((SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0)) END, :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_transitions (rider_id, id, trip_id, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, at) SELECT t.rider_id, t.id || ':' || 'cancelled', t.id, t.status, 'cancelled', 'rider', :__user_id, json_object('source', 'rider', 'reason_code', CASE WHEN :reason_code IN ('changed_plans', 'wait_too_long', 'wrong_pickup', 'found_other', 'other') THEN :reason_code ELSE 'other' END, 'fee_cents', CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' THEN MIN(800, coalesce((SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0)) WHEN :__now - (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) <= 120000 THEN 0 ELSE MIN(500, coalesce((SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0)) END, 'fee_policy', CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' THEN 'arrived_cancel' WHEN :__now - (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) <= 120000 THEN 'free_grace' ELSE 'late_cancel' END), :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, type, status, at) SELECT t.rider_id, t.id || ':' || 'cancelled', t.id, 'status', 'cancelled', :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL

UPDATE ride_requests SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = ride_requests.rider_id AND t.request_id = ride_requests.id AND t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL)

UPDATE dispatch_requests SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = :__now WHERE status IN ('searching', 'matched') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = dispatch_requests.rider_id AND t.request_id = dispatch_requests.request_id AND t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO notifications (user_id, id, kind, role, trip_id, request_id, rider_id, link, params, critical, actor_id, created_at, read_at, push_status, push_attempts, push_next_at, push_error, email_status, email_attempts, email_next_at, email_error) SELECT c.recipient, c.nid, 'trip_cancelled', 'driver', c.trip_id, c.request_id, c.rider_id, c.link, c.params, 1, :__user_id, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN coalesce(np.push, 1) = 1 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'skipped' END, 0, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN 1 = 1 AND coalesce(np.email_fallback, 0) = 1 AND coalesce(np.push, 1) = 0 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'none' END, 0, :__now, NULL FROM (SELECT (SELECT d.user_id FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id) AS recipient, t.id || ':' || 'trip_cancelled' || ':' || 'driver' AS nid, t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id AS request_id, t.rider_id AS rider_id, '/driver/trip/' || t.rider_id || '/' || t.request_id AS link, json_object('by', 'rider', 'reason', (SELECT l.cancel_code FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id), 'fee_cents', (SELECT l.cancel_fee_cents FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id)) AS params FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL) c LEFT JOIN notification_prefs np ON np.user_id = c.recipient WHERE c.recipient IS NOT NULL AND c.recipient != :__user_id

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO fare_statements (rider_id, trip_id, request_id, driver_user_id, receipt_no, basis, currency, quote_id, quoted_cents, base_cents, distance_cents, time_cents, booking_fee_cents, min_adjust_cents, surge_milli, final_cents, tax_rate_bp, tax_cents, commission_bp, platform_fee_cents, driver_payout_cents, policy_version, outcome, pickup_label, dropoff_label, finalized_at) SELECT c.rider_id, c.trip_id, c.request_id, c.driver_user_id, 'RCT-' || substr(:__uuid, 1, 8), c.basis, 'USD', c.quote_id, c.quoted, c.base, c.dist, c.tim, c.fee, c.adj, c.surge, c.final, 0, c.final - (c.final * 10000 + 5000) / 10000, 0, (c.final * 0 + 5000) / 10000, c.final - (c.final - (c.final * 10000 + 5000) / 10000) - (c.final * 0 + 5000) / 10000, 'v0-unconfigured', c.outcome, c.pickup, c.dropoff, :__now FROM (SELECT t.rider_id AS rider_id, t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id AS request_id, (SELECT d.user_id FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id) AS driver_user_id, l.outcome AS outcome, CASE WHEN l.outcome = 'completed' THEN 'fare' WHEN l.outcome = 'rider_no_show' AND l.cancel_fee_cents > 0 THEN 'no_show_fee' WHEN l.cancel_fee_cents > 0 THEN 'cancellation_fee' ELSE 'none' END AS basis, f.id AS quote_id, coalesce(f.total_cents, (SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0) AS quoted, f.base_cents AS base, f.distance_cents AS dist, f.time_cents AS tim, f.booking_fee_cents AS fee, f.min_adjust_cents AS adj, f.surge_milli AS surge, CASE WHEN l.outcome = 'completed' THEN coalesce(f.total_cents, (SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0) ELSE l.cancel_fee_cents END AS final, r.pickup_label AS pickup, r.dropoff_label AS dropoff FROM trips t JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id LEFT JOIN fare_quotes f ON f.rider_id = t.rider_id AND f.ride_id = t.request_id AND f.status = 'accepted' WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL) c

UPDATE dispatch_requests SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND request_id = :request_id AND status IN ('searching', 'matched') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND (t.status = 'completed' OR (t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)))

tools.name: advance_trip
tools.description: Driver: move the assigned trip one step: scheduled -> en_route -> arrived, and arrived -> completed only after start_trip. Cancelling is a separate action (driver_cancel_trip). Invalid transitions, repeated requests, unassigned trips and other drivers' trips change nothing and write no audit row. Completing releases the driver's dispatch lock and completes the ride request. Completing deletes the trip's live location. Finalizes the immutable fare statement for the trip. Queues in-app and push notifications for the other party. Keeps a coarse position snapshot as dispute evidence for 30 days.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_lifecycle (rider_id, trip_id, updated_at) SELECT t.rider_id, t.id, :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL))

INSERT INTO trip_lifecycle_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, event, actor_id, actor_role, reason_code, note, amount_cents, at) SELECT t.rider_id, :__uuid, t.id, 'completed', :__user_id, 'driver', NULL, NULL, NULL, :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)) AND :to_status = 'completed'

UPDATE trip_lifecycle SET outcome = 'completed', ended_at = :__now, updated_at = :__now WHERE :to_status = 'completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = trip_lifecycle.rider_id AND t.id = trip_lifecycle.trip_id AND t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)))

UPDATE ride_requests SET status = 'completed', updated_at = :__now WHERE :to_status = 'completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = ride_requests.rider_id AND t.request_id = ride_requests.id AND t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)))

UPDATE dispatch_offers SET status = 'completed', responded_at = :__now WHERE status = 'accepted' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = dispatch_offers.rider_id AND t.request_id = dispatch_offers.request_id AND t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO notifications (user_id, id, kind, role, trip_id, request_id, rider_id, link, params, critical, actor_id, created_at, read_at, push_status, push_attempts, push_next_at, push_error, email_status, email_attempts, email_next_at, email_error) SELECT c.recipient, c.nid, 'driver_en_route', 'rider', c.trip_id, c.request_id, c.rider_id, c.link, c.params, 0, :__user_id, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN coalesce(np.push, 1) = 1 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'skipped' END, 0, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN 0 = 1 AND coalesce(np.email_fallback, 0) = 1 AND coalesce(np.push, 1) = 0 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'none' END, 0, :__now, NULL FROM (SELECT t.rider_id AS recipient, t.id || ':' || 'driver_en_route' AS nid, t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id AS request_id, t.rider_id AS rider_id, '/trip/' || t.request_id AS link, json_object() AS params FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)) AND :to_status = 'en_route') c LEFT JOIN notification_prefs np ON np.user_id = c.recipient WHERE c.recipient IS NOT NULL AND c.recipient != :__user_id

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO notifications (user_id, id, kind, role, trip_id, request_id, rider_id, link, params, critical, actor_id, created_at, read_at, push_status, push_attempts, push_next_at, push_error, email_status, email_attempts, email_next_at, email_error) SELECT c.recipient, c.nid, 'driver_arrived', 'rider', c.trip_id, c.request_id, c.rider_id, c.link, c.params, 1, :__user_id, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN coalesce(np.push, 1) = 1 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'skipped' END, 0, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN 1 = 1 AND coalesce(np.email_fallback, 0) = 1 AND coalesce(np.push, 1) = 0 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'none' END, 0, :__now, NULL FROM (SELECT t.rider_id AS recipient, t.id || ':' || 'driver_arrived' AS nid, t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id AS request_id, t.rider_id AS rider_id, '/trip/' || t.request_id AS link, json_object() AS params FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)) AND :to_status = 'arrived') c LEFT JOIN notification_prefs np ON np.user_id = c.recipient WHERE c.recipient IS NOT NULL AND c.recipient != :__user_id

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO fare_statements (rider_id, trip_id, request_id, driver_user_id, receipt_no, basis, currency, quote_id, quoted_cents, base_cents, distance_cents, time_cents, booking_fee_cents, min_adjust_cents, surge_milli, final_cents, tax_rate_bp, tax_cents, commission_bp, platform_fee_cents, driver_payout_cents, policy_version, outcome, pickup_label, dropoff_label, finalized_at) SELECT c.rider_id, c.trip_id, c.request_id, c.driver_user_id, 'RCT-' || substr(:__uuid, 1, 8), c.basis, 'USD', c.quote_id, c.quoted, c.base, c.dist, c.tim, c.fee, c.adj, c.surge, c.final, 0, c.final - (c.final * 10000 + 5000) / 10000, 0, (c.final * 0 + 5000) / 10000, c.final - (c.final - (c.final * 10000 + 5000) / 10000) - (c.final * 0 + 5000) / 10000, 'v0-unconfigured', c.outcome, c.pickup, c.dropoff, :__now FROM (SELECT t.rider_id AS rider_id, t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id AS request_id, (SELECT d.user_id FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id) AS driver_user_id, l.outcome AS outcome, CASE WHEN l.outcome = 'completed' THEN 'fare' WHEN l.outcome = 'rider_no_show' AND l.cancel_fee_cents > 0 THEN 'no_show_fee' WHEN l.cancel_fee_cents > 0 THEN 'cancellation_fee' ELSE 'none' END AS basis, f.id AS quote_id, coalesce(f.total_cents, (SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0) AS quoted, f.base_cents AS base, f.distance_cents AS dist, f.time_cents AS tim, f.booking_fee_cents AS fee, f.min_adjust_cents AS adj, f.surge_milli AS surge, CASE WHEN l.outcome = 'completed' THEN coalesce(f.total_cents, (SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0) ELSE l.cancel_fee_cents END AS final, r.pickup_label AS pickup, r.dropoff_label AS dropoff FROM trips t JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id LEFT JOIN fare_quotes f ON f.rider_id = t.rider_id AND f.ride_id = t.request_id AND f.status = 'accepted' WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)) AND :to_status = 'completed') c

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO notifications (user_id, id, kind, role, trip_id, request_id, rider_id, link, params, critical, actor_id, created_at, read_at, push_status, push_attempts, push_next_at, push_error, email_status, email_attempts, email_next_at, email_error) SELECT c.recipient, c.nid, 'receipt_ready', 'rider', c.trip_id, c.request_id, c.rider_id, c.link, c.params, 1, :__user_id, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN coalesce(np.push, 1) = 1 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'skipped' END, 0, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN 1 = 1 AND coalesce(np.email_fallback, 0) = 1 AND coalesce(np.push, 1) = 0 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'none' END, 0, :__now, NULL FROM (SELECT t.rider_id AS recipient, t.id || ':' || 'receipt_ready' AS nid, t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id AS request_id, t.rider_id AS rider_id, '/trip/' || t.request_id AS link, json_object('total_cents', (SELECT s.final_cents FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = t.rider_id AND s.trip_id = t.id)) AS params FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)) AND :to_status = 'completed') c LEFT JOIN notification_prefs np ON np.user_id = c.recipient WHERE c.recipient IS NOT NULL AND c.recipient != :__user_id

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_evidence (rider_id, trip_id, kind, lat, lng, accuracy_m, age_ms, captured_at) SELECT l.rider_id, l.trip_id, CASE WHEN :to_status = 'arrived' THEN 'arrived' ELSE 'ended' END, l.lat, l.lng, l.accuracy_m, :__now - l.updated_at, :__now FROM trip_locations l JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = l.rider_id AND t.id = l.trip_id WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)) AND :to_status IN ('arrived', 'completed') AND :__now - l.updated_at <= 60000

DELETE FROM trip_locations WHERE :to_status = 'completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = trip_locations.rider_id AND t.id = trip_locations.trip_id AND t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)))

UPDATE trips SET status = :to_status, updated_at = :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = trips.rider_id AND t.id = trips.id AND t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND ((t.status = 'scheduled' AND :to_status = 'en_route') OR (t.status = 'en_route' AND :to_status = 'arrived') OR (t.status = 'arrived' AND :to_status = 'completed' AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NOT NULL)))

tools.name: list_my_trips
tools.description: List the caller's trips as a rider, newest first, optionally filtered by status
tools.sql: SELECT t.id, t.request_id, t.assignment_id, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, r.pickup_label, r.dropoff_label FROM trips t JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND (:status IS NULL OR t.status = :status) ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_my_trip_history
tools.description: The caller's append-only transition history for one of their trips, oldest first (who moved it, when, and metadata)
tools.sql: SELECT id, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, at FROM trip_transitions WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND trip_id = :trip_id ORDER BY at, rowid

tools.name: list_driver_trips
tools.description: List trips assigned to the caller's linked driver account, newest first, optionally filtered by status
tools.sql: SELECT t.rider_id, t.id, t.request_id, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, r.pickup_label, r.dropoff_label, r.scheduled_for FROM trips t JOIN assignments a ON a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id WHERE d.user_id = :__user_id AND (:status IS NULL OR t.status = :status) ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_driver_trip_history
tools.description: Transition history for one trip assigned to the caller's linked driver account, oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT x.id, x.from_status, x.to_status, x.actor_type, x.metadata, x.at FROM trip_transitions x JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = x.rider_id AND t.id = x.trip_id JOIN assignments a ON a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE x.rider_id = :rider_id AND x.trip_id = :trip_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY x.at, x.rowid

tools.name: get_rider_profile
tools.description: The caller's rider profile and contact preferences (no row until first saved)
tools.sql: SELECT display_name, phone, notify_email, notify_sms, notify_trip_updates, updated_at FROM rider_profiles WHERE rider_id = :__user_id

tools.name: save_rider_profile
tools.description: Create or update the caller's rider profile and contact preferences
tools.sql: INSERT INTO rider_profiles (rider_id, display_name, phone, notify_email, notify_sms, notify_trip_updates, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :display_name, :phone, :notify_email, :notify_sms, :notify_trip_updates, :__now, :__now) ON CONFLICT (rider_id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = excluded.display_name, phone = excluded.phone, notify_email = excluded.notify_email, notify_sms = excluded.notify_sms, notify_trip_updates = excluded.notify_trip_updates, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

tools.name: list_saved_places
tools.description: List the caller's saved places (Home, Work, ...)
tools.sql: SELECT id, label, address, lat, lng, created_at FROM saved_places WHERE rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: save_place
tools.description: Create or update one of the caller's saved places. At most 50 saved places per rider; further new places are ignored.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO saved_places (rider_id, id, label, address, lat, lng, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :place_id, :label, :address, :lat, :lng, :__now, :__now WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_places s WHERE s.rider_id = :__user_id) < 50 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_places s WHERE s.rider_id = :__user_id AND s.id = :place_id) ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET label = excluded.label, address = excluded.address, lat = excluded.lat, lng = excluded.lng, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

tools.name: delete_place
tools.description: Delete one of the caller's saved places
tools.sql: DELETE FROM saved_places WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND id = :place_id

tools.name: list_trip_history

tools.sql: SELECT r.id, r.booking_type, r.status, r.pickup_label, r.dropoff_label, r.recurring_days, r.pickup_time, r.scheduled_for, r.vehicle_class, r.created_at, r.updated_at, t.status AS trip_status, q.fare_cents FROM ride_requests r LEFT JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = r.rider_id AND t.request_id = r.id LEFT JOIN quotes q ON q.rider_id = r.rider_id AND q.request_id = r.id WHERE r.rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_my_driver_application
tools.description: The caller's own driver application, status and the reason for the last decision (no row until started)
tools.sql: SELECT status, full_name, phone, licence_number, licence_region, licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed, status_reason, submitted_at, reviewed_at, updated_at FROM driver_applications WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: save_driver_application
tools.description: Create or edit the caller's driver application (profile, licence and eligibility). Only while it is a draft or was rejected; submitted, approved and suspended applications are locked. Licence details are private: visible only to the applicant and ops.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO driver_applications (user_id, status, full_name, phone, licence_number, licence_region, licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, 'draft', :full_name, :phone, :licence_number, :licence_region, :licence_expires, :eligibility_confirmed, :__now, :__now) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET full_name = excluded.full_name, phone = excluded.phone, licence_number = excluded.licence_number, licence_region = excluded.licence_region, licence_expires = excluded.licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed = excluded.eligibility_confirmed, updated_at = excluded.updated_at WHERE driver_applications.status IN ('draft', 'rejected')

tools.name: list_my_driver_vehicles
tools.description: The caller's vehicles with their approval status and reason
tools.sql: SELECT id, plate, make, model, year, colour, seats, vehicle_class, status, status_reason FROM driver_vehicles WHERE user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at

tools.name: save_driver_vehicle
tools.description: Add or edit one of the caller's vehicles. Changing any detail of an existing vehicle sends it back to pending review and takes the driver off dispatch if it was the active vehicle. At most 10 vehicles per driver; further new vehicles are ignored.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_vehicles (user_id, id, plate, make, model, year, colour, seats, vehicle_class, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :vehicle_id, :plate, :make, :model, :year, :colour, :seats, :vehicle_class, 'pending', :__now, :__now WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driver_vehicles x WHERE x.user_id = :__user_id) < 10 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles x WHERE x.user_id = :__user_id AND x.id = :vehicle_id) ON CONFLICT (user_id, id) DO UPDATE SET status = CASE WHEN driver_vehicles.plate IS excluded.plate AND driver_vehicles.make IS excluded.make AND driver_vehicles.model IS excluded.model AND driver_vehicles.year IS excluded.year AND driver_vehicles.colour IS excluded.colour AND driver_vehicles.seats IS excluded.seats AND driver_vehicles.vehicle_class IS excluded.vehicle_class THEN driver_vehicles.status ELSE 'pending' END, plate = excluded.plate, make = excluded.make, model = excluded.model, year = excluded.year, colour = excluded.colour, seats = excluded.seats, vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND vehicle_id = :vehicle_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = :__user_id AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND v.status = 'approved')

tools.name: delete_driver_vehicle
tools.description: Remove one of the caller's vehicles (and take the driver off dispatch if it was the active vehicle)
statements: UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND vehicle_id = :vehicle_id
DELETE FROM driver_vehicles WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND id = :vehicle_id

tools.name: submit_driver_application
tools.description: Submit the caller's application for review. Needs name, phone, licence number/region/expiry, confirmed eligibility and at least one vehicle. Only from draft or rejected. Audited.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, a.user_id, NULL, a.status, 'submitted', NULL, :__user_id, 'applicant', :__now FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id AND a.status IN ('draft', 'rejected') AND a.full_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.full_name) != '' AND a.phone IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.phone) != '' AND a.licence_number IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.licence_number) != '' AND a.licence_region IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.licence_region) != '' AND a.licence_expires IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.licence_expires) != '' AND a.eligibility_confirmed = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = a.user_id)

UPDATE driver_applications SET status = 'submitted', status_reason = NULL, submitted_at = :__now, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND status IN ('draft', 'rejected') AND full_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(full_name) != '' AND phone IS NOT NULL AND trim(phone) != '' AND licence_number IS NOT NULL AND trim(licence_number) != '' AND licence_region IS NOT NULL AND trim(licence_region) != '' AND licence_expires IS NOT NULL AND trim(licence_expires) != '' AND eligibility_confirmed = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = driver_applications.user_id)

tools.name: list_my_driver_review_log
tools.description: The audit trail of decisions on the caller's application and vehicles, oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_role, at FROM driver_review_log WHERE user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY at, rowid

tools.name: get_my_driver_availability
tools.description: Whether the caller is currently available for dispatch, and with which vehicle
tools.sql: SELECT available, vehicle_id, updated_at FROM driver_availability WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: set_driver_availability
tools.description: Go on or off dispatch. Going available only works for an approved (not suspended) driver with an unexpired licence and an approved vehicle; otherwise nothing changes. Going unavailable always works. Going offline also withdraws any open offer to the driver. Going available also needs the dispatch_availability location consent. Going offline erases the stored dispatch position.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_availability (user_id, available, vehicle_id, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :available, :vehicle_id, :__now WHERE :available = 0 OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id AND a.status = 'approved' AND a.licence_expires >= date(:__now / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND v.status = 'approved') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM location_consents c WHERE c.user_id = :__user_id AND c.purpose = 'dispatch_availability' AND c.granted = 1)) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET available = excluded.available, vehicle_id = COALESCE(excluded.vehicle_id, driver_availability.vehicle_id), updated_at = excluded.updated_at
UPDATE dispatch_offers SET status = 'cancelled', responded_at = :__now WHERE driver_id = :__user_id AND status = 'offered' AND :available = 0
DELETE FROM driver_locations WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND :available = 0

tools.name: list_driver_applications
tools.description: Ops: driver applications, oldest submission first, optionally by status. Personal details are redacted (first initial, phone's last 2 digits, licence's last 4 characters); full details need ops_pii and a logged reason (ops_log_access, then get_driver_application_detail). Excludes the caller's own application.
tools.sql: SELECT a.user_id, a.status, CASE WHEN a.full_name IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE substr(a.full_name, 1, 1) || '.' END AS initial, CASE WHEN a.phone IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE '***' || substr(a.phone, -2) END AS phone_masked, substr(a.licence_number, -4) AS licence_last4, a.licence_region, a.licence_expires, a.submitted_at, a.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = a.user_id) AS vehicle_count FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id != :__user_id AND (:status IS NULL OR a.status = :status) ORDER BY a.submitted_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_driver_application_detail
tools.description: Ops (ops_pii): one application in full, including name, phone and licence number. Returns nothing unless the caller logged a reason for this driver in the last 10 minutes (ops_log_access scope driver_pii).
tools.sql: SELECT user_id, status, full_name, phone, licence_number, licence_region, licence_expires, eligibility_confirmed, status_reason, submitted_at, reviewed_at, reviewed_by FROM driver_applications WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'driver_pii' AND g.driver_user_id = :driver_user_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000)

tools.name: list_driver_vehicles_for_review
tools.description: Ops: a driver's vehicles
tools.sql: SELECT id, plate, make, model, year, colour, seats, vehicle_class, status, status_reason FROM driver_vehicles WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id ORDER BY created_at

tools.name: list_driver_review_log
tools.description: Ops: the audit trail for one driver (who decided what, when and why), oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at FROM driver_review_log WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id ORDER BY at, rowid

tools.name: review_driver_application
tools.description: Ops: decide a submitted application: approved or rejected. Rejecting needs a reason. Approving also approves the driver's pending vehicles. Cannot review your own application. Audited in the driver review log. Suspending and reinstating a driver are separate actions that require a reason code (ops_suspend_driver, ops_reinstate_driver).
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, a.user_id, NULL, a.status, :decision, :reason, :__user_id, 'ops', :__now FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND ((a.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) ) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE driver_vehicles SET status = 'approved', status_reason = NULL, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND status = 'pending' AND :decision = 'approved' AND :driver_user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND ((a.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) ) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0) AND a.status = 'submitted')

UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND :decision IN ('rejected', 'suspended') AND :driver_user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND ((a.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) ) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0))

UPDATE driver_applications SET status = :decision, status_reason = CASE WHEN :decision = 'approved' THEN NULL ELSE trim(:reason) END, reviewed_at = :__now, reviewed_by = :__user_id, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND ((driver_applications.status = 'submitted' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) ) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

tools.name: review_driver_vehicle
tools.description: Ops: approve or reject one vehicle (pending -> approved|rejected, approved -> rejected). Rejecting needs a reason and takes the driver off dispatch if it was their active vehicle. Audited.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, v.user_id, v.id, v.status, :decision, :reason, :__user_id, 'ops', :__now FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = :driver_user_id AND v.user_id != :__user_id AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND ((v.status = 'pending' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (v.status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'rejected')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND vehicle_id = :vehicle_id AND :decision = 'rejected' AND :driver_user_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_vehicles v WHERE v.user_id = :driver_user_id AND v.id = :vehicle_id AND v.status IN ('pending', 'approved') AND length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE driver_vehicles SET status = :decision, status_reason = CASE WHEN :decision = 'approved' THEN NULL ELSE trim(:reason) END, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND id = :vehicle_id AND ((status = 'pending' AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected')) OR (status = 'approved' AND :decision = 'rejected')) AND (:decision = 'approved' OR length(trim(coalesce(:reason, ''))) > 0)

tools.name: list_dispatchable_drivers
tools.description: Ops/dispatch: drivers who are available right now AND still approved, with an approved vehicle and an unexpired licence. Suspension, rejection or licence expiry removes a driver here even if their availability flag is stale. The driver's name is shown as an initial only; full details need the ops_pii role and a logged reason.
tools.sql: SELECT d.user_id, CASE WHEN a.full_name IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE substr(a.full_name, 1, 1) || '.' END AS initial, v.id AS vehicle_id, v.plate, v.vehicle_class, v.seats FROM driver_availability d JOIN driver_applications a ON a.user_id = d.user_id JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = d.user_id AND v.id = d.vehicle_id WHERE d.available = 1 AND a.status = 'approved' AND v.status = 'approved' AND a.licence_expires >= date(:__now / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.updated_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: update_driver_location
tools.description: Driver: publish the caller's current position and the radius (0.5-50 km) they will serve around it. Only approved drivers; out-of-range values change nothing. Dispatch ignores locations older than 5 minutes, so keep publishing while online. Requires the driver's location consent for dispatch_availability (set_location_consent); without it nothing is stored.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO driver_locations (user_id, lat, lng, service_radius_km, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :lat, :lng, :service_radius_km, :__now WHERE :lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND :lng BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND :service_radius_km BETWEEN 0.5 AND 50 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id AND a.status = 'approved') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM location_consents c WHERE c.user_id = :__user_id AND c.purpose = 'dispatch_availability' AND c.granted = 1) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET lat = excluded.lat, lng = excluded.lng, service_radius_km = excluded.service_radius_km, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

tools.name: get_my_driver_location
tools.description: The caller's last published position and service radius
tools.sql: SELECT lat, lng, service_radius_km, updated_at FROM driver_locations WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: list_my_offers
tools.description: Driver: the caller's live dispatch offer (unexpired) or accepted assignment, with pickup, drop-off and fare
tools.sql: SELECT o.rider_id, o.request_id, o.status, o.distance_km2, o.offered_at, o.expires_at, r.pickup_label, r.pickup_lat, r.pickup_lng, r.dropoff_label, r.vehicle_class, q.fare_cents FROM dispatch_offers o JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = o.rider_id AND r.id = o.request_id LEFT JOIN quotes q ON q.rider_id = o.rider_id AND q.request_id = o.request_id WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND (o.status = 'accepted' OR (o.status = 'offered' AND o.expires_at > :__now)) ORDER BY o.offered_at

tools.name: accept_offer
tools.description: Driver: accept the caller's live offer. Atomic: succeeds only while the offer is unexpired, the request is still searching and the driver is still eligible and available. On success the rider gets an assignment and a scheduled trip, the request becomes matched, and the driver is linked to the trip so advance_trip works. Otherwise nothing changes. Queues in-app and push notifications for the other party.
statements: UPDATE dispatch_offers SET status = 'accepted', responded_at = :__now WHERE driver_id = :__user_id AND rider_id = :rider_id AND request_id = :request_id AND status = 'offered' AND expires_at > :__now AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_availability da JOIN driver_applications a ON a.user_id = da.user_id JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = da.user_id AND v.id = dispatch_offers.vehicle_id WHERE da.user_id = :__user_id AND da.available = 1 AND a.status = 'approved' AND a.licence_expires >= date(:__now / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND v.status = 'approved') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_requests dr WHERE dr.rider_id = :rider_id AND dr.request_id = :request_id AND dr.status = 'searching') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ride_requests r WHERE r.rider_id = :rider_id AND r.id = :request_id AND r.status = 'open')

INSERT INTO drivers (rider_id, id, display_name, user_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :rider_id, 'drv_u_' || :__user_id, a.full_name, :__user_id, 'active', :__now, :__now FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_offers o WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND o.rider_id = :rider_id AND o.request_id = :request_id AND o.status = 'accepted') ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = excluded.display_name, user_id = excluded.user_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO vehicles (rider_id, id, driver_id, plate, vehicle_class, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :rider_id, 'veh_' || v.id, 'drv_u_' || :__user_id, v.plate, v.vehicle_class, :__now, :__now FROM dispatch_offers o JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = o.driver_id AND v.id = o.vehicle_id WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND o.rider_id = :rider_id AND o.request_id = :request_id AND o.status = 'accepted' ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = excluded.driver_id, plate = excluded.plate, vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO assignments (rider_id, id, request_id, driver_id, vehicle_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :rider_id, :request_id || ':' || 'assignment', :request_id, 'drv_u_' || :__user_id, 'veh_' || o.vehicle_id, 'accepted', :__now, :__now FROM dispatch_offers o WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND o.rider_id = :rider_id AND o.request_id = :request_id AND o.status = 'accepted' ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = excluded.driver_id, vehicle_id = excluded.vehicle_id, status = 'accepted', updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO trips (rider_id, id, request_id, assignment_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :rider_id, :request_id || ':' || 'trip', :request_id, :request_id || ':' || 'assignment', 'scheduled', :__now, :__now FROM dispatch_offers o WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND o.rider_id = :rider_id AND o.request_id = :request_id AND o.status = 'accepted' ON CONFLICT (rider_id, id) DO UPDATE SET assignment_id = excluded.assignment_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_transitions (rider_id, id, trip_id, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, at) SELECT :rider_id, :request_id || ':' || 'trip' || ':' || 'scheduled', :request_id || ':' || 'trip', NULL, 'scheduled', 'driver', :__user_id, '{"source":"dispatch"}', :__now FROM dispatch_offers o WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND o.rider_id = :rider_id AND o.request_id = :request_id AND o.status = 'accepted'

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trip_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, type, status, at) SELECT :rider_id, :request_id || ':' || 'trip' || ':' || 'scheduled', :request_id || ':' || 'trip', 'status', 'scheduled', :__now FROM dispatch_offers o WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND o.rider_id = :rider_id AND o.request_id = :request_id AND o.status = 'accepted'

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO notifications (user_id, id, kind, role, trip_id, request_id, rider_id, link, params, critical, actor_id, created_at, read_at, push_status, push_attempts, push_next_at, push_error, email_status, email_attempts, email_next_at, email_error) SELECT c.recipient, c.nid, 'driver_assigned', 'rider', c.trip_id, c.request_id, c.rider_id, c.link, c.params, 1, :__user_id, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN coalesce(np.push, 1) = 1 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'skipped' END, 0, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN 1 = 1 AND coalesce(np.email_fallback, 0) = 1 AND coalesce(np.push, 1) = 0 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'none' END, 0, :__now, NULL FROM (SELECT :rider_id AS recipient, :request_id || ':' || 'trip' || ':' || 'driver_assigned' AS nid, :request_id || ':' || 'trip' AS trip_id, :request_id AS request_id, :rider_id AS rider_id, '/trip/' || :request_id AS link, json_object('driver', a.full_name, 'plate', v.plate) AS params FROM dispatch_offers o JOIN driver_applications a ON a.user_id = o.driver_id JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = o.driver_id AND v.id = o.vehicle_id WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND o.rider_id = :rider_id AND o.request_id = :request_id AND o.status = 'accepted') c LEFT JOIN notification_prefs np ON np.user_id = c.recipient WHERE c.recipient IS NOT NULL AND c.recipient != :__user_id

UPDATE ride_requests SET status = 'matched', updated_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :rider_id AND id = :request_id AND status = 'open' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_offers o WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND o.rider_id = :rider_id AND o.request_id = :request_id AND o.status = 'accepted')

UPDATE dispatch_requests SET status = 'matched', updated_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :rider_id AND request_id = :request_id AND status = 'searching' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_offers o WHERE o.driver_id = :__user_id AND o.rider_id = :rider_id AND o.request_id = :request_id AND o.status = 'accepted')

tools.name: decline_offer
tools.description: Driver: decline the caller's live offer. The rider's next dispatch_tick offers the request to the next driver.
tools.sql: UPDATE dispatch_offers SET status = 'declined', responded_at = :__now WHERE driver_id = :__user_id AND rider_id = :rider_id AND request_id = :request_id AND status = 'offered'

tools.name: request_dispatch
tools.description: Rider: start (or restart, after no_driver or cancel) driver search for one of the caller's open on-demand requests that has pickup coordinates. Save the ride first. Searching lasts 2 minutes and offers go to at most 3 drivers. Refused while the rider has another active on-demand request. Refused while dispatch is paused by operations. Refused while the rider is blocked by operations.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO dispatch_requests (rider_id, request_id, status, pickup_lat, pickup_lng, vehicle_class, attempts, started_at, deadline_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, r.id, 'searching', r.pickup_lat, r.pickup_lng, r.vehicle_class, 0, :__now, :__now + 120000, :__now FROM ride_requests r WHERE r.rider_id = :__user_id AND r.id = :request_id AND r.booking_type = 'now' AND r.status = 'open' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_requests d JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = d.rider_id AND r.id = d.request_id WHERE d.rider_id = :__user_id AND d.request_id != :request_id AND r.status IN ('open', 'matched') AND ((d.status = 'searching' AND d.deadline_at >= :__now) OR (d.status = 'matched' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips x WHERE x.rider_id = d.rider_id AND x.request_id = d.request_id AND x.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled'))))) AND coalesce((SELECT f.paused FROM service_flag_log f WHERE f.name = 'dispatch' ORDER BY f.at DESC, f.rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 0) = 0 AND coalesce((SELECT l.action FROM rider_block_log l WHERE l.rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY l.at DESC, l.rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 'lifted') != 'blocked' AND r.pickup_lat IS NOT NULL AND r.pickup_lng IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (rider_id, request_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'searching', pickup_lat = excluded.pickup_lat, pickup_lng = excluded.pickup_lng, vehicle_class = excluded.vehicle_class, attempts = 0, started_at = excluded.started_at, deadline_at = excluded.deadline_at, updated_at = excluded.updated_at WHERE dispatch_requests.status IN ('no_driver', 'cancelled')

tools.name: dispatch_tick
tools.description: Rider: advance dispatch for one request. Expires stale offers (sweeping all expired offers so a silent driver is never locked), offers the request to the best eligible driver if none is live, then marks the search no_driver once 3 offers are spent or the 2 minute window passes. Idempotent: call it every few seconds until get_dispatch_status is matched, no_driver or cancelled. Queues in-app and push notifications for the other party.
statements: UPDATE dispatch_offers SET status = 'expired', responded_at = :__now WHERE status = 'offered' AND expires_at <= :__now AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dispatch_offers (rider_id, request_id, attempt, driver_id, vehicle_id, status, distance_km2, offered_at, expires_at) SELECT dr.rider_id, dr.request_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM dispatch_offers x WHERE x.rider_id = dr.rider_id AND x.request_id = dr.request_id), da.user_id, da.vehicle_id, 'offered', (((l.lat - dr.pickup_lat) * (l.lat - dr.pickup_lat) + (l.lng - dr.pickup_lng) * (l.lng - dr.pickup_lng) * (1 - ((dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295)) / 2 + ((dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295)) / 24 - ((dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295)) / 720) * (1 - ((dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295)) / 2 + ((dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295)) / 24 - ((dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295)) / 720)) * 12364.5), :__now, :__now + 30000 FROM dispatch_requests dr JOIN driver_availability da ON da.available = 1 JOIN driver_applications a ON a.user_id = da.user_id JOIN driver_vehicles v ON v.user_id = da.user_id AND v.id = da.vehicle_id JOIN driver_locations l ON l.user_id = da.user_id WHERE dr.rider_id = :__user_id AND dr.request_id = :request_id AND dr.status = 'searching' AND :__now <= dr.deadline_at AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch_offers x WHERE x.rider_id = dr.rider_id AND x.request_id = dr.request_id AND x.offered_at >= dr.started_at) < 3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_offers o WHERE o.rider_id = dr.rider_id AND o.request_id = dr.request_id AND o.status IN ('offered', 'accepted')) AND a.status = 'approved' AND a.licence_expires >= date(:__now / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND v.status = 'approved' AND (CASE coalesce(v.vehicle_class, 'share') WHEN 'share' THEN 0 WHEN 'comfort' THEN 1 WHEN 'xl' THEN 2 END) >= (CASE coalesce(dr.vehicle_class, 'share') WHEN 'share' THEN 0 WHEN 'comfort' THEN 1 WHEN 'xl' THEN 2 END) AND l.updated_at >= :__now - 300000 AND da.user_id != dr.rider_id AND (((l.lat - dr.pickup_lat) * (l.lat - dr.pickup_lat) + (l.lng - dr.pickup_lng) * (l.lng - dr.pickup_lng) * (1 - ((dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295)) / 2 + ((dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295) * (dr.pickup_lat * 0.017453292519943295)) / 24 -
