statements: INSERT INTO trip_lifecycle_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, event, actor_id, actor_role, reason_code, note, amount_cents, at) SELECT t.rider_id, :__uuid, t.id, 'dispute_opened', :__user_id, CASE WHEN t.rider_id = :__user_id THEN 'rider' ELSE 'driver' END, :reason_code, substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), NULL, :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND coalesce((SELECT l.ended_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id), t.updated_at) >= :__now - 604800000 AND (t.rider_id = :__user_id AND :reason_code IN ('overcharged', 'route', 'driver_conduct', 'cancel_fee', 'other') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :reason_code IN ('rider_conduct', 'cancel_fee', 'damage', 'other')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id AND x.opened_by = :__user_id)

INSERT INTO trip_disputes (rider_id, trip_id, opened_by, opened_role, reason_code, note, status, opened_at) SELECT t.rider_id, t.id, :__user_id, CASE WHEN t.rider_id = :__user_id THEN 'rider' ELSE 'driver' END, :reason_code, substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), 'open', :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND coalesce((SELECT l.ended_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id), t.updated_at) >= :__now - 604800000 AND (t.rider_id = :__user_id AND :reason_code IN ('overcharged', 'route', 'driver_conduct', 'cancel_fee', 'other') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :reason_code IN ('rider_conduct', 'cancel_fee', 'damage', 'other')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id AND x.opened_by = :__user_id) ON CONFLICT (rider_id, trip_id, opened_by) DO NOTHING

tools.name: list_my_disputes
tools.description: Disputes the caller has opened, newest first, with the decision and note once resolved
tools.sql: SELECT rider_id, trip_id, opened_role, reason_code, note, status, opened_at, decision, resolution_note, resolved_at, fee_waived FROM trip_disputes WHERE opened_by = :__user_id ORDER BY opened_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: ops_list_disputes
tools.description: Ops: disputes by status (default open), oldest first, with the trip outcome and any cancellation fee
tools.sql: SELECT p.rider_id, p.trip_id, p.opened_by, p.opened_role, p.reason_code, p.note, p.status, p.opened_at, p.decision, p.resolution_note, l.outcome, l.cancel_fee_cents, l.fee_policy FROM trip_disputes p LEFT JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = p.rider_id AND l.trip_id = p.trip_id WHERE p.rider_id != :__user_id AND p.opened_by != :__user_id AND p.status = coalesce(:status, 'open') ORDER BY p.opened_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: ops_resolve_dispute
tools.description: Ops: decide one open dispute (upheld or rejected) with a mandatory note; upholding may also waive the trip's cancellation fee. Audited. Cannot act on trips where the caller is a participant. Resolved disputes cannot be reopened. A waiver is recorded as a credit adjustment against the immutable statement. Queues in-app and push notifications for the other party.
statements: INSERT INTO trip_lifecycle_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, event, actor_id, actor_role, reason_code, note, amount_cents, at) SELECT t.rider_id, :__uuid || ':' || 'fee', t.id, 'fee_waived', :__user_id, 'ops', 'dispute', substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), (SELECT l.cancel_fee_cents FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id), :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :decision IN ('upheld', 'rejected') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :opened_by AND p.status = 'open') AND :decision = 'upheld' AND :waive_fee = 1 AND coalesce((SELECT l.cancel_fee_cents FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id), 0) > 0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO fare_adjustments (rider_id, id, trip_id, kind, amount_cents, reason_code, note, actor_id, created_at) SELECT s.rider_id, 'dispute-waiver:' || s.trip_id || ':' || :opened_by, s.trip_id, 'credit', s.final_cents - coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0), 'dispute_waiver', substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), :__user_id, :__now FROM fare_statements s JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = s.rider_id AND t.id = s.trip_id WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :decision IN ('upheld', 'rejected') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :opened_by AND p.status = 'open') AND :decision = 'upheld' AND :waive_fee = 1 AND coalesce((SELECT l.cancel_fee_cents FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id), 0) > 0 AND s.final_cents - coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) > 0

UPDATE trip_lifecycle SET cancel_fee_cents = 0, fee_policy = 'ops_waived', updated_at = :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = trip_lifecycle.rider_id AND t.id = trip_lifecycle.trip_id AND t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :decision IN ('upheld', 'rejected') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :opened_by AND p.status = 'open') AND :decision = 'upheld' AND :waive_fee = 1 AND coalesce((SELECT l.cancel_fee_cents FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id), 0) > 0)

INSERT INTO trip_lifecycle_events (rider_id, id, trip_id, event, actor_id, actor_role, reason_code, note, amount_cents, at) SELECT t.rider_id, :__uuid, t.id, 'dispute_resolved', :__user_id, 'ops', :decision, substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), NULL, :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :decision IN ('upheld', 'rejected') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :opened_by AND p.status = 'open')

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO notifications (user_id, id, kind, role, trip_id, request_id, rider_id, link, params, critical, actor_id, created_at, read_at, push_status, push_attempts, push_next_at, push_error, email_status, email_attempts, email_next_at, email_error) SELECT c.recipient, c.nid, 'dispute_resolved', 'rider', c.trip_id, c.request_id, c.rider_id, c.link, c.params, 0, :__user_id, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN coalesce(np.push, 1) = 1 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'skipped' END, 0, :__now, NULL, CASE WHEN 0 = 1 AND coalesce(np.email_fallback, 0) = 1 AND coalesce(np.push, 1) = 0 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'none' END, 0, :__now, NULL FROM (SELECT :opened_by AS recipient, t.id || ':' || 'dispute_resolved' || ':' || :opened_by AS nid, t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id AS request_id, t.rider_id AS rider_id, CASE WHEN :opened_by = t.rider_id THEN '/trip/' || t.request_id ELSE '/driver/trip/' || t.rider_id || '/' || t.request_id END AS link, json_object('decision', :decision) AS params FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :decision IN ('upheld', 'rejected') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :opened_by AND p.status = 'open')) c LEFT JOIN notification_prefs np ON np.user_id = c.recipient WHERE c.recipient IS NOT NULL AND c.recipient != :__user_id

UPDATE trip_disputes SET status = 'resolved', decision = :decision, resolution_note = substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), resolved_by = :__user_id, resolved_at = :__now, fee_waived = CASE WHEN :decision = 'upheld' AND :waive_fee = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = trip_disputes.rider_id AND l.trip_id = trip_disputes.trip_id AND l.fee_policy = 'ops_waived') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE rider_id = :rider_id AND trip_id = :trip_id AND opened_by = :opened_by AND status = 'open' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :decision IN ('upheld', 'rejected') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :opened_by AND p.status = 'open'))

tools.name: get_my_trip_lifecycle
tools.description: Rider: the authoritative state of the caller's trip for a ride request: phase (scheduled, en_route, arrived, in_progress, completed, cancelled), who ended it and why, and any cancellation fee
tools.sql: SELECT t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id, t.status, CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' AND l.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'in_progress' ELSE t.status END AS phase, l.started_at, l.ended_at, l.outcome, l.cancelled_by_role, l.cancel_code, l.cancel_note, coalesce(l.cancel_fee_cents, 0) AS cancel_fee_cents, l.fee_policy, (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) AS assigned_at, t.updated_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :__user_id) AS disputed FROM trips t LEFT JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id

tools.name: get_driver_trip
tools.description: Driver: the authoritative state of a trip assigned to the caller, with pickup, drop-off and the time they arrived (for the rider no-show wait)
tools.sql: SELECT t.id AS trip_id, t.request_id, t.status, CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' AND l.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'in_progress' ELSE t.status END AS phase, l.started_at, l.ended_at, l.outcome, l.cancelled_by_role, l.cancel_code, l.cancel_note, coalesce(l.cancel_fee_cents, 0) AS cancel_fee_cents, l.fee_policy, (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) AS assigned_at, t.updated_at, r.pickup_label, r.pickup_lat, r.pickup_lng, r.dropoff_label, r.dropoff_lat, r.dropoff_lng, (SELECT MAX(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id AND x.to_status = 'arrived') AS arrived_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_disputes p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id AND p.opened_by = :__user_id) AS disputed FROM trips t JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id LEFT JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id)

tools.name: preview_cancellation
tools.description: Rider: what cancelling this ride would cost right now (fee_cents and policy). No row means no trip is assigned yet, so cancelling is free.
tools.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' THEN MIN(800, coalesce((SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0)) WHEN :__now - (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) <= 120000 THEN 0 ELSE MIN(500, coalesce((SELECT q.fare_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.rider_id = t.rider_id AND q.request_id = t.request_id), 0)) END AS fee_cents, CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' THEN 'arrived_cancel' WHEN :__now - (SELECT MIN(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id) <= 120000 THEN 'free_grace' ELSE 'late_cancel' END AS policy FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND (SELECT l.started_at FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id) IS NULL

tools.name: list_my_trip_events
tools.description: Rider: lifecycle events (started, completed, cancelled, no_show, disputes) for the caller's trip, oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT event, actor_role, reason_code, note, amount_cents, at FROM trip_lifecycle_events WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND trip_id = :trip_id ORDER BY at, rowid

tools.name: ops_get_trip_timeline
tools.description: Ops: a trip's full history, status transitions and lifecycle events interleaved by time. Cannot read trips the caller rides or drives.
tools.sql: SELECT kind, name, actor, detail, at FROM (SELECT 'transition' AS kind, x.to_status AS name, x.actor_type || ':' || x.actor_id AS actor, coalesce(x.metadata, '') AS detail, x.at AS at FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = :rider_id AND x.trip_id = :trip_id UNION ALL SELECT 'event', e.event, e.actor_role || ':' || e.actor_id, coalesce(e.reason_code, '') || ' ' || coalesce(e.note, ''), e.at FROM trip_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.rider_id = :rider_id AND e.trip_id = :trip_id) WHERE :rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id)) ORDER BY at

tools.name: publish_driver_location
tools.description: Driver: publish the assigned driver's position for a trip. Accepted only from the assigned driver while the trip is en_route or arrived (including in progress), never before they start driving or after the trip ends; at most one update per 3s (faster calls are dropped); implausible coordinates, accuracy (>500 m) or speed are dropped. Coordinates are rounded to 4 decimals (about 11 m) before storing. Only the latest position is kept, overwritten in place, and it is deleted when the trip ends; positions older than 24 hours are purged on every publish. Requires the driver's location consent for trip_tracking (set_location_consent); without it nothing is stored.
statements: DELETE FROM trip_evidence WHERE captured_at < :__now - 2592000000 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM trip_locations WHERE updated_at < :__now - 86400000 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO trip_locations (rider_id, trip_id, driver_id, lat, lng, accuracy_m, speed_mps, updated_at) SELECT t.rider_id, t.id, :__user_id, ROUND(:lat, 4), ROUND(:lng, 4), :accuracy_m, :speed_mps, :__now FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.status IN ('en_route', 'arrived') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id AND d.user_id = :__user_id) AND :lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND :lng BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND coalesce(:accuracy_m, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 500 AND coalesce(:speed_mps, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 70 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM location_consents c WHERE c.user_id = :__user_id AND c.purpose = 'trip_tracking' AND c.granted = 1) ON CONFLICT (rider_id, trip_id) DO UPDATE SET lat = excluded.lat, lng = excluded.lng, accuracy_m = excluded.accuracy_m, speed_mps = excluded.speed_mps, driver_id = excluded.driver_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at WHERE :__now - trip_locations.updated_at >= 3000

tools.name: get_driver_location
tools.description: Rider: the assigned driver's latest position for the caller's own ride, with its age in milliseconds measured by the server clock. Returns a row only while the trip is en_route or arrived (including in progress); nothing before the driver starts driving or after the trip ends. The driver cannot read it, and no one else can.
tools.sql: SELECT l.lat, l.lng, l.accuracy_m, l.speed_mps, :__now - l.updated_at AS age_ms, t.status AS trip_status FROM trip_locations l JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = l.rider_id AND t.id = l.trip_id WHERE l.rider_id = :__user_id AND t.request_id = :request_id AND t.status IN ('en_route', 'arrived')

tools.name: ops_credit_trip
tools.description: Ops: credit part or all of a finished trip's charge (reason goodwill, fare_error, duplicate_charge or other; a note is required). The immutable statement is untouched; a credit row is appended. The total credited can never exceed the statement's final amount, so a fare cannot be driven below zero or raised. request_key makes retries safe: repeating a key does nothing. Cannot be used on trips the caller rode or drove. No money moves; payment collection is not enabled.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO fare_adjustments (rider_id, id, trip_id, kind, amount_cents, reason_code, note, actor_id, created_at) SELECT s.rider_id, :request_key, s.trip_id, 'credit', :amount_cents, :reason_code, substr(trim(:note), 1, 200), :__user_id, :__now FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = :rider_id AND s.trip_id = :trip_id AND s.rider_id != :__user_id AND coalesce(s.driver_user_id, '') != :__user_id AND length(trim(coalesce(:request_key, ''))) > 0 AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND (:reason_code = 'goodwill' OR :reason_code = 'fare_error' OR :reason_code = 'duplicate_charge' OR :reason_code = 'other') AND :amount_cents > 0 AND :amount_cents <= s.final_cents - coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0)

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Rider: the receipt for one of the caller's finished rides: the immutable statement (quote, fare components, fee or fare, tax) plus credits applied and the resulting total. Payment is not collected in the app yet, so this is a statement of what is owed, not proof of payment.
tools.sql: SELECT s.receipt_no, s.trip_id, s.request_id, s.basis, s.currency, s.outcome, s.quoted_cents, s.base_cents, s.distance_cents, s.time_cents, s.booking_fee_cents, s.min_adjust_cents, s.surge_milli, s.final_cents, s.tax_rate_bp, s.tax_cents, s.pickup_label, s.dropoff_label, s.finalized_at, coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) AS credits_cents, s.final_cents - coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) AS total_cents FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = :__user_id AND s.request_id = :request_id

tools.name: list_my_receipts
tools.description: Rider: the caller's receipts, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT s.receipt_no, s.trip_id, s.request_id, s.basis, s.currency, s.outcome, s.quoted_cents, s.base_cents, s.distance_cents, s.time_cents, s.booking_fee_cents, s.min_adjust_cents, s.surge_milli, s.final_cents, s.tax_rate_bp, s.tax_cents, s.pickup_label, s.dropoff_label, s.finalized_at, coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) AS credits_cents, s.final_cents - coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) AS total_cents FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY s.finalized_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: list_receipt_adjustments
tools.description: Rider: credits applied to one of the caller's receipts, oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT id, kind, amount_cents, reason_code, note, created_at FROM fare_adjustments WHERE rider_id = :__user_id AND trip_id = :trip_id ORDER BY created_at, rowid

tools.name: list_my_earnings
tools.description: Driver: statements for trips the caller drove, newest first: the fare basis, the amount, tax, the platform fee and the driver's payout accrual under the policy in force when the trip ended. Accrual only; no payout is executed.
tools.sql: SELECT s.receipt_no, s.trip_id, s.basis, s.currency, s.final_cents, s.tax_cents, s.platform_fee_cents, s.driver_payout_cents, s.policy_version, s.outcome, s.finalized_at, coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) AS credits_cents FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.driver_user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY s.finalized_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: ops_reconcile
tools.description: Ops: reconciliation of money records to trip data. Returns one row per problem (missing_statement, fare_not_quote, quote_changed, components_mismatch, fee_not_lifecycle, credits_exceed_final, refunds_without_payment, payout_mismatch, adjustment_without_statement); an empty result means every statement ties back to its trip, quote, and credits. Excludes trips the caller rode or drove.
tools.sql: SELECT r.rider_id, r.trip_id, r.code, r.detail FROM (SELECT t.rider_id AS rider_id, t.id AS trip_id, 'missing_statement' AS code, l.outcome AS detail FROM trips t JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id WHERE t.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND l.outcome IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = t.rider_id AND s.trip_id = t.id) UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'fare_not_quote' AS code, s.final_cents || ' vs quoted ' || s.quoted_cents AS detail FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.basis = 'fare' AND s.final_cents != s.quoted_cents UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'quote_changed' AS code, s.quoted_cents || ' vs now ' || q.fare_cents AS detail FROM fare_statements s JOIN quotes q ON q.rider_id = s.rider_id AND q.request_id = s.request_id WHERE s.quoted_cents != q.fare_cents UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'components_mismatch' AS code, s.quoted_cents || ' vs ' || ((s.base_cents + s.distance_cents + s.time_cents + s.booking_fee_cents + s.min_adjust_cents) * s.surge_milli + 500) / 1000 AS detail FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.base_cents IS NOT NULL AND ((s.base_cents + s.distance_cents + s.time_cents + s.booking_fee_cents + s.min_adjust_cents) * s.surge_milli + 500) / 1000 != s.quoted_cents UNION l.rider_id = s.rider_id AND l.trip_id = s.trip_id WHERE s.basis != 'fare' AND s.final_cents != l.cancel_fee_cents + coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id AND x.reason_code = 'dispute_waiver'), 0) UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'credits_exceed_final' AS code, coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) || ' vs ' || s.final_cents AS detail FROM fare_statements s WHERE coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) > s.final_cents UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'refunds_without_payment' AS code, 'no payment is recorded' AS detail FROM fare_statements s WHERE coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id AND x.kind = 'refund'), 0) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT s.rider_id AS rider_id, s.trip_id AS trip_id, 'payout_mismatch' AS code, s.driver_payout_cents AS detail FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.final_cents - s.tax_cents - s.platform_fee_cents != s.driver_payout_cents UNION ALL SELECT x.rider_id AS rider_id, x.trip_id AS trip_id, 'adjustment_without_statement' AS code, x.id AS detail tools.name: delete_my_driver_data
tools.description: Erase everything the caller owns as a driver: their application (licence data), vehicles, availability, last position and live location, and unlink their driver account from other riders' trips. Irreversible and idempotent. Account deletion calls this and delete_my_rider_data (a batch is limited to 25 statements). Driver review-log rows are kept for audit. Also erases the caller's diagnostic events and counters. Also erases the caller's location consent records.
statements: DELETE FROM client_events WHERE user_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM client_metrics WHERE user_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM trip_locations WHERE driver_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM driver_locations WHERE user_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM driver_availability WHERE user_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM driver_vehicles WHERE user_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM driver_applications WHERE user_id = :__user_id
UPDATE drivers SET user_id = NULL WHERE user_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM location_consents WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: get_notification_prefs
tools.description: The caller's notification preferences: language (en or es), push on/off (default on, still needs browser permission), and email fallback (default off; on only after explicit consent, with the time it was given)
tools.sql: SELECT locale, push, email_fallback, email_consent_at, updated_at FROM notification_prefs WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: set_notification_prefs
tools.description: Set the caller's notification preferences. Turning email fallback on records the consent time (keeping the original if already on); turning it off clears it. Turning push off or email off takes effect immediately: undelivered notifications for that channel are marked skipped. SMS is not offered: the SDK only lets the app's creator send SMS.
statements: INSERT INTO notification_prefs (user_id, locale, push, email_fallback, email_consent_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, CASE WHEN :locale IN ('en', 'es') THEN :locale ELSE 'en' END, :push, :email_fallback, CASE WHEN :email_fallback = 1 THEN :__now END, :__now) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET locale = excluded.locale, push = excluded.push, email_fallback = excluded.email_fallback, email_consent_at = CASE WHEN excluded.email_fallback = 1 THEN coalesce(notification_prefs.email_consent_at, excluded.email_consent_at) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
UPDATE notifications SET push_status = 'skipped', push_next_at = NULL WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND push_status IN ('pending', 'retry') AND :push = 0
UPDATE notifications SET email_status = 'skipped', email_next_at = NULL WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND email_status IN ('pending', 'retry') AND :email_fallback = 0

tools.name: list_my_notifications
tools.description: The caller's notifications, newest first, with the trip link and the parameters the app renders in the caller's language
tools.sql: SELECT id, kind, role, trip_id, request_id, rider_id, link, params, critical, created_at, read_at FROM notifications WHERE user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark one notification (id) or all of the caller's unread notifications read. Also deletes the caller's notifications older than 30 days.
statements: DELETE FROM notifications WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND created_at < :__now - 2592000000
UPDATE notifications SET read_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND read_at IS NULL AND (:id IS NULL OR id = :id)

tools.name: list_pending_deliveries
tools.description: Deliveries the caller owes: notifications caused by the caller's own actions whose push (due now) or, once push has finished, email fallback is still to be sent. The recipient's language is included so the message is written for them. Email appears only while the recipient's consent is still on.
tools.sql: SELECT n.user_id AS recipient, n.id, n.kind, n.link, n.params, n.critical, n.created_at, CASE WHEN n.push_status IN ('pending', 'retry') THEN 'push' ELSE 'email' END AS channel, coalesce(np.locale, 'en') AS locale FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN notification_prefs np ON np.user_id = n.user_id WHERE n.actor_id = :__user_id AND ((n.push_status IN ('pending', 'retry') AND n.push_next_at <= :__now AND coalesce(np.push, 1) = 1) OR (n.push_status NOT IN ('pending', 'retry') AND n.email_status IN ('pending', 'retry') AND n.email_next_at <= :__now AND coalesce(np.email_fallback, 0) = 1)) ORDER BY n.created_at LIMIT 20

tools.name: report_push_result
tools.description: Record the outcome of a push the caller attempted: 'sent', or 'failed'. A failure is retried (after 30 s, then 2 min) up to 3 attempts, then marked failed; a critical notification whose push finally failed becomes eligible for email fallback if the recipient consented. Only the person whose action caused the notification can report it.
tools.sql: UPDATE notifications SET push_status = CASE WHEN :outcome = 'sent' THEN 'sent' WHEN push_attempts + 1 >= 3 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'retry' END, push_attempts = push_attempts + 1, push_next_at = CASE WHEN :outcome = 'sent' OR push_attempts + 1 >= 3 THEN NULL WHEN push_attempts + 1 = 1 THEN :__now + 30000 ELSE :__now + 120000 END, push_error = CASE WHEN :outcome = 'failed' THEN substr(trim(coalesce(:error, '')), 1, 100) END, email_status = CASE WHEN :outcome = 'failed' AND push_attempts + 1 >= 3 AND critical = 1 AND email_status = 'none' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_prefs np WHERE np.user_id = notifications.user_id AND np.email_fallback = 1) THEN 'pending' ELSE email_status END WHERE user_id = :recipient AND id = :notification_id AND actor_id = :__user_id AND push_status IN ('pending', 'retry') AND :outcome IN ('sent', 'failed')

tools.name: report_email_result
tools.description: Record the outcome of an email fallback the caller attempted: 'sent', 'skipped' (the platform reports the recipient unsubscribed or has no address; final) or 'failed' (retried like push, up to 3 attempts). Only the person whose action caused the notification can report it.
tools.sql: UPDATE notifications SET email_status = CASE WHEN :outcome = 'sent' THEN 'sent' WHEN :outcome = 'skipped' THEN 'skipped' WHEN email_attempts + 1 >= 3 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'retry' END, email_attempts = email_attempts + 1, email_next_at = CASE WHEN :outcome IN ('sent', 'skipped') OR email_attempts + 1 >= 3 THEN NULL WHEN email_attempts + 1 = 1 THEN :__now + 30000 ELSE :__now + 120000 END, email_error = CASE WHEN :outcome IN ('failed', 'skipped') THEN substr(trim(coalesce(:error, '')), 1, 100) END WHERE user_id = :recipient AND id = :notification_id AND actor_id = :__user_id AND email_status IN ('pending', 'retry') AND :outcome IN ('sent', 'skipped', 'failed')

tools.name: ops_list_notification_issues
tools.description: Ops: delivery problems, oldest first: pushes or emails that failed after 3 attempts, and notifications still undelivered after 10 minutes (the person whose action caused them has not come back online to send them). Shows kind and status only, never the message parameters.
tools.sql: SELECT user_id, id, kind, 'push_failed' AS code, push_error AS detail, created_at FROM notifications WHERE push_status = 'failed' AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT user_id, id, kind, 'email_failed', email_error, created_at FROM notifications WHERE email_status = 'failed' UNION ALL SELECT user_id, id, kind, 'undelivered', CASE WHEN push_status IN ('pending', 'retry') THEN 'push ' || push_status ELSE 'email ' || email_status END, created_at FROM notifications WHERE created_at < :__now - 600000 AND (push_status IN ('pending', 'retry') OR (push_status NOT IN ('pending', 'retry') AND email_status IN ('pending', 'retry'))) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: ops_search_trips
tools.description: Ops: search trips by exact trip id, ride id, receipt number, rider id or driver id (no partial matching), optionally by status; newest first. Redacted: ids, status, outcome, vehicle class, amounts, dispatch state and whether a dispute is open, but no names, addresses, plates or coordinates. Excludes trips the caller rode or drove.

tools.name: ops_log_access
tools.description: Ops (ops_pii): record why you need to see personal data, before you see it. scope trip_pii (names, addresses, plate), evidence (exact coordinates) or driver_pii (licence details); reason_code is one of dispute, safety_incident, support_ticket, fraud_check, legal_request. The matching read action returns data only for 10 minutes after this. Every access is listed in the audit log.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO ops_access_log (id, actor_id, scope, rider_id, trip_id, driver_user_id, reason_code, at) SELECT :__uuid, :__user_id, :scope, :rider_id, :trip_id, :driver_user_id, :reason_code, :__now WHERE :scope IN ('trip_pii', 'evidence', 'driver_pii') AND :reason_code IN ('dispute', 'safety_incident', 'support_ticket', 'fraud_check', 'legal_request') AND ((:scope = 'driver_pii' AND :driver_user_id IS NOT NULL AND :driver_user_id != :__user_id) OR (:scope != 'driver_pii' AND :rider_id IS NOT NULL AND :trip_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND coalesce((SELECT d.user_id FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id), '') != :__user_id)))

tools.name: ops_get_trip_pii
tools.description: Ops (ops_pii): the personal details for a trip: pickup and drop-off addresses, rider's name, driver's name and plate. Returns nothing unless the caller logged a trip_pii access for this trip in the last 10 minutes.
tools.sql: SELECT t.id AS trip_id, r.pickup_label, r.dropoff_label, (SELECT p.display_name FROM rider_profiles p WHERE p.rider_id = t.rider_id) AS rider_name, (SELECT a.full_name FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = (SELECT d.user_id FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id)) AS driver_name, (SELECT v.plate FROM assignments s JOIN vehicles v ON v.rider_id = s.rider_id AND v.id = s.vehicle_id WHERE s.rider_id = t.rider_id AND s.id = t.assignment_id) AS plate FROM trips t JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND coalesce((SELECT d.user_id FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id), '') != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'trip_pii' AND g.rider_id = :rider_id AND g.trip_id = :trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000)

tools.name: ops_get_trip_evidence_pii
tools.description: Ops (ops_pii): the exact coordinates of a trip's evidence snapshots. Returns nothing unless the caller logged an evidence access for this trip in the last 10 minutes.
tools.sql: SELECT e.kind, e.lat, e.lng, e.accuracy_m, e.captured_at FROM trip_evidence e JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = e.rider_id AND t.id = e.trip_id WHERE e.rider_id = :rider_id AND e.trip_id = :trip_id AND t.rider_id != :__user_id AND coalesce((SELECT d.user_id FROM assignments a JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id WHERE a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id), '') != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'evidence' AND g.rider_id = :rider_id AND g.trip_id = :trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000) ORDER BY e.captured_at

tools.name: ops_suspend_driver
tools.description: Ops: suspend an approved driver with a reason code (safety, fraud_suspected, document_expired, repeated_cancellations, complaint, other) and a note. Takes them off dispatch, withdraws any open offer, and blocks going available. A trip already in progress is not touched; cancel it separately. Audited in the driver review log with actor, time, code and note. Cannot suspend yourself.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, a.user_id, NULL, a.status, 'suspended', :reason_code || ': ' || substr(trim(:note), 1, 200), :__user_id, 'ops', :__now FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND a.status = 'approved' AND :reason_code IN ('safety', 'fraud_suspected', 'document_expired', 'repeated_cancellations', 'complaint', 'other') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0

UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND a.status = 'approved' AND :reason_code IN ('safety', 'fraud_suspected', 'document_expired', 'repeated_cancellations', 'complaint', 'other') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE dispatch_offers SET status = 'cancelled', responded_at = :__now WHERE driver_id = :driver_user_id AND status = 'offered' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND a.status = 'approved' AND :reason_code IN ('safety', 'fraud_suspected', 'document_expired', 'repeated_cancellations', 'complaint', 'other') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0)

UPDATE driver_applications SET status = 'suspended', status_reason = :reason_code || ': ' || substr(trim(:note), 1, 200), reviewed_at = :__now, reviewed_by = :__user_id, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND status = 'approved' AND :reason_code IN ('safety', 'fraud_suspected', 'document_expired', 'repeated_cancellations', 'complaint', 'other') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0

tools.name: ops_reinstate_driver
tools.description: Ops: lift a suspension with a reason code (review_complete, documents_renewed, error, other) and a note. The driver must go available again themselves. Audited in the driver review log. Cannot reinstate yourself.
statements: INSERT INTO driver_review_log (id, user_id, vehicle_id, from_status, to_status, reason, actor_id, actor_role, at) SELECT :__uuid, a.user_id, NULL, a.status, 'approved', :reason_code || ': ' || substr(trim(:note), 1, 200), :__user_id, 'ops', :__now FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id AND a.user_id != :__user_id AND a.status = 'suspended' AND :reason_code IN ('review_complete', 'documents_renewed', 'error', 'other') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0

UPDATE driver_applications SET status = 'approved', status_reason = NULL, reviewed_at = :__now, reviewed_by = :__user_id, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :driver_user_id AND user_id != :__user_id AND status = 'suspended' AND :reason_code IN ('review_complete', 'documents_renewed', 'error', 'other') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0

tools.name: ops_request_refund
tools.description: Ops: request a refund for a finished trip with a reason code (overcharged, service_failure, duplicate_charge, cancel_fee_dispute, other) and a note. The amount can't exceed what is still unrefunded after credits and other open or approved requests. This only records the request for a second person to decide; no money moves, because payments are not enabled (docs/adr/0001). request_key makes retries safe.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO refund_requests (rider_id, id, trip_id, amount_cents, reason_code, note, status, requested_by, requested_at) SELECT s.rider_id, :request_key, s.trip_id, :amount_cents, :reason_code, substr(trim(:note), 1, 200), 'requested', :__user_id, :__now FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = :rider_id AND s.trip_id = :trip_id AND s.rider_id != :__user_id AND coalesce(s.driver_user_id, '') != :__user_id AND length(trim(coalesce(:request_key, ''))) > 0 AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND :reason_code IN ('overcharged', 'service_failure', 'duplicate_charge', 'cancel_fee_dispute', 'other') AND :amount_cents > 0 AND :amount_cents <= s.final_cents - coalesce((SELECT SUM(x.amount_cents) FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.rider_id = s.rider_id AND x.trip_id = s.trip_id), 0) - coalesce((SELECT SUM(f.amount_cents) FROM refund_requests f WHERE f.rider_id = s.rider_id AND f.trip_id = s.trip_id AND f.status IN ('requested', 'approved')), 0)

tools.name: ops_list_refund_requests
tools.description: Ops: refund requests by status (default requested), oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT f.rider_id, f.id AS request_key, f.trip_id, f.amount_cents, f.reason_code, f.note, f.status, f.requested_by, f.requested_at, f.decided_by, f.decided_at, f.decision_note FROM refund_requests f WHERE f.rider_id != :__user_id AND f.status = coalesce(:status, 'requested') ORDER BY f.requested_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: ops_decide_refund
tools.description: Ops: approve or reject a refund request with a note. A different person from the requester must decide (four-eyes), and not someone who rode or drove the trip. Approval is recorded as the decision only; it moves no money while payments are not enabled.
tools.sql: UPDATE refund_requests SET status = :decision, decided_by = :__user_id, decided_at = :__now, decision_note = substr(trim(:note), 1, 200) WHERE rider_id = :rider_id AND id = :request_key AND status = 'requested' AND requested_by != :__user_id AND rider_id != :__user_id AND :decision IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fare_statements s WHERE s.rider_id = refund_requests.rider_id AND s.trip_id = refund_requests.trip_id AND s.driver_user_id = :__user_id)

tools.name: ops_escalate
tools.description: Ops: escalate a trip or a driver to a lead, safety or legal reviewer with a reason code (safety, legal_request, fraud, abuse, regulator_or_press, other) and a note. Give a trip (rider_id and trip_id), a driver (driver_user_id), or both. request_key makes retries safe.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO ops_escalations (id, rider_id, trip_id, driver_user_id, level, reason_code, note, status, opened_by, opened_at) SELECT :request_key, :rider_id, :trip_id, :driver_user_id, :level, :reason_code, substr(trim(:note), 1, 200), 'open', :__user_id, :__now WHERE length(trim(coalesce(:request_key, ''))) > 0 AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND :level IN ('lead', 'safety', 'legal') AND :reason_code IN ('safety', 'legal_request', 'fraud', 'abuse', 'regulator_or_press', 'other') AND ((:rider_id IS NOT NULL AND :trip_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id)) OR (:rider_id IS NULL AND :trip_id IS NULL AND :driver_user_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM driver_applications a WHERE a.user_id = :driver_user_id)))

tools.name: ops_list_escalations
tools.description: Ops: escalations by status (default open), oldest first
tools.sql: SELECT id, rider_id, trip_id, driver_user_id, level, reason_code, note, status, opened_by, opened_at, resolved_by, resolved_at, resolution_note FROM ops_escalations WHERE status = coalesce(:status, 'open') AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY opened_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: ops_resolve_escalation
tools.description: Ops: close an open escalation with a resolution note. Someone other than the person who opened it must resolve it.
tools.sql: UPDATE ops_escalations SET status = 'resolved', resolved_by = :__user_id, resolved_at = :__now, resolution_note = substr(trim((:note)), 1, 200) WHERE id = :request_key AND status = 'open' AND opened_by != :__user_id AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0

tools.name: ops_list_audit
tools.description: Ops: every staff action in one list, newest first, each with the actor, time, target, reason code and note: trip cancellations, fee waivers, dispute decisions, credits, driver approvals/rejections/suspensions/reinstatements, vehicle decisions, refund requests and decisions, escalations and their resolution, every personal-data access, and every pause or resume of dispatch, every safety report acknowledgement and resolution, and every rider block and unblock. Filter by trip or actor.
tools.sql: SELECT at, action, actor_id, rider_id, trip_id, driver_user_id, reason_code, note, amount_cents FROM (SELECT e.at AS at, CASE e.event WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'trip_cancelled' WHEN 'fee_waived' THEN 'fee_waived' ELSE e.event END AS action, e.actor_id AS actor_id, e.rider_id AS rider_id, e.trip_id AS trip_id, NULL AS driver_user_id, e.reason_code AS reason_code, e.note AS note, e.amount_cents AS amount_cents FROM trip_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.actor_role = 'ops' UNION ALL SELECT x.created_at, 'credit', x.actor_id, x.rider_id, x.trip_id, NULL, x.reason_code, x.note, x.amount_cents FROM fare_adjustments x WHERE x.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM driver_review_log UNION SELECT actor_id FROM trip_lifecycle_events WHERE actor_role = 'ops' UNION SELECT requested_by FROM refund_requests UNION SELECT opened_by FROM ops_escalations UNION SELECT actor_id FROM ops_access_log UNION SELECT :__user_id) UNION ALL SELECT g.at, 'driver_' || g.to_status, g.actor_id, NULL, NULL, g.user_id, g.vehicle_id, g.reason, NULL FROM driver_review_log g WHERE g.actor_role = 'ops' UNION ALL SELECT f.requested_at, 'refund_requested', f.requested_by, f.rider_id, f.trip_id, NULL, f.reason_code, f.note, f.amount_cents FROM refund_requests f UNION ALL SELECT f.decided_at, 'refund_' || f.status, f.decided_by, f.rider_id, f.trip_id, NULL, NULL, f.decision_note, f.amount_cents FROM refund_requests f WHERE f.decided_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.opened_at, 'escalated_' || s.level, s.opened_by, s.rider_id, s.trip_id, s.driver_user_id, s.reason_code, s.note, NULL FROM ops_escalations s UNION ALL SELECT s.resolved_at, 'escalation_resolved', s.resolved_by, s.rider_id, s.trip_id, s.driver_user_id, NULL, s.resolution_note, NULL FROM ops_escalations s WHERE s.resolved_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.at, 'pii_access_' || a.scope, a.actor_id, a.rider_id, a.trip_id, a.driver_user_id, a.reason_code, NULL, NULL FROM ops_access_log a UNION ALL SELECT s.at, CASE WHEN s.paused = 1 THEN 'service_paused' ELSE 'service_resumed' END, s.actor_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, s.reason_code, s.note, NULL FROM service_flag_log s UNION ALL SELECT b.at, CASE b.action WHEN 'blocked' THEN 'rider_blocked' ELSE 'rider_block_lifted' END, b.actor_id, b.rider_id, NULL, NULL, b.reason_code, b.note, NULL FROM rider_block_log b UNION ALL SELECT r.acknowledged_at, 'safety_report_acknowledged', r.acknowledged_by, r.rider_id, r.trip_id, NULL, r.category, NULL, NULL FROM safety_reports r WHERE r.acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT r.resolved_at, 'safety_report_resolved', r.resolved_by, r.rider_id, r.trip_id, NULL, r.resolution_code, r.resolution_note, NULL FROM safety_reports r WHERE r.resolved_at IS NOT NULL) WHERE (:trip_id IS NULL OR trip_id = :trip_id) AND (:actor IS NULL OR actor_id = :actor) ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: report_client_event
tools.description: Any signed-in user: report a structured, non-personal diagnostic event (domain request, dispatch, tracking, notification, payment, maps, transition; a short snake_case code; the action involved; HTTP status; latency; opaque trip and ride ids; severity warn or error; a detail clipped to 200 characters). At most 20 per minute per person; invalid values are dropped. Events older than 14 days are purged on every call. Never include names, addresses, coordinates or contact details.
statements: DELETE FROM client_events WHERE at < :__now - 1209600000 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO client_events (user_id, id, at, domain, code, action, status, latency_ms, trip_id, request_id, severity, detail) SELECT :__user_id, :__uuid, :__now, :domain, :code, substr(:action, 1, 60), :status, :latency_ms, substr(:trip_id, 1, 80), substr(:request_id, 1, 80), :severity, substr(trim(coalesce(:detail, '')), 1, 200) WHERE :domain IN ('request', 'dispatch', 'tracking', 'notification', 'payment', 'maps', 'transition') AND :severity IN ('warn', 'error') AND length(:code) BETWEEN 3 AND 40 AND :code NOT GLOB '*[^a-z_]*' AND coalesce(:status, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 999 AND coalesce(:latency_ms, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 3600000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client_events e WHERE e.user_id = :__user_id AND e.at > :__now - 60000) < 20

tools.name: report_client_metrics
tools.description: Any signed-in user: add this minute's call counters. payload is a JSON array (at most 4000 characters, one element per domain) of {"d": domain, "c": calls, "e": errors, "s": slow calls, "l": summed latency ms}. Elements with an unknown domain or out-of-range numbers are dropped; counters for the same minute and domain are added together.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO client_metrics (user_id, minute, domain, calls, errors, slow, latency_sum_ms) SELECT :__user_id, CAST(:__now AS INTEGER) / 60000, json_extract(j.value, '$.d'), json_extract(j.value, '$.c'), json_extract(j.value, '$.e'), json_extract(j.value, '$.s'), json_extract(j.value, '$.l') FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:payload) AND length(:payload) <= 4000 THEN :payload ELSE '[]' END) j WHERE json_extract(j.value, '$.d') IN ('request', 'dispatch', 'tracking', 'notification', 'payment', 'maps', 'transition') AND json_extract(j.value, '$.c') BETWEEN 1 AND 100000 AND json_extract(j.value, '$.e') BETWEEN 0 AND json_extract(j.value, '$.c') AND json_extract(j.value, '$.s') BETWEEN 0 AND json_extract(j.value, '$.c') AND json_extract(j.value, '$.l') BETWEEN 0 AND 3600000000 LIMIT 7 ON CONFLICT (user_id, minute, domain) DO UPDATE SET calls = calls + excluded.calls, errors = errors + excluded.errors, slow = slow + excluded.slow, latency_sum_ms = latency_sum_ms + excluded.latency_sum_ms

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Any signed-in user: whether ride dispatch is currently paused by operations (so the app can say so instead of failing).
tools.sql: SELECT coalesce((SELECT f.paused FROM service_flag_log f WHERE f.name = 'dispatch' ORDER BY f.at DESC, f.rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS dispatch_paused WHERE :__user_id IS NOT NULL

tools.name: ops_set_service_flag
tools.description: Ops: pause or resume ride dispatch (name dispatch) with a reason code (dispatch_outage, maintenance, incident, resolved) and a note. While paused, new ride requests and quote acceptances are refused with a clear message; searches already running, active trips, tracking and notifications are untouched. Appended to the audit log.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO service_flag_log (id, name, paused, reason_code, note, actor_id, at) SELECT :__uuid, :name, :paused, :reason_code, substr(trim(:note), 1, 200), :__user_id, :__now WHERE :name = 'dispatch' AND :paused IN (0, 1) AND :reason_code IN ('dispatch_outage', 'maintenance', 'incident', 'resolved') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND :paused != coalesce((SELECT f.paused FROM service_flag_log f WHERE f.name = 'dispatch' ORDER BY f.at DESC, f.rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 0)

tools.name: ops_health_alerts
tools.description: Ops: every health check with whether it is firing, its current value, its threshold and the runbook to follow, over a window of 5-120 minutes (default 15). Firing checks come first, critical before warning. Covers matching failures, driver offer timeouts, paused dispatch, stale and degraded location tracking, inconsistent trip/ride/offer states, rejected trip steps, failed and undelivered notifications, fare-statement problems, urgent safety reports nobody has acknowledged for 5 minutes, and elevated failure rates per domain.
tools.sql: SELECT a.code, a.domain, a.severity, a.firing, a.value, a.threshold, a.message, a.runbook FROM (SELECT 'matching_failures' AS code, 'dispatch' AS domain, 'critical' AS severity, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.status IN ('matched', 'no_driver') AND d.updated_at >= :__now - (:window_min * 60000)) >= 3 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.status = 'no_driver' AND d.updated_at >= :__now - (:window_min * 60000)) * 2 >= (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.status IN ('matched', 'no_driver') AND d.updated_at >= :__now - (:window_min * 60000)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS firing, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.status IN ('matched', 'no_driver') AND d.updated_at >= :__now - (:window_min * 60000)) = tools.description: Ops: call counts, failures, slow calls (over 2 s), average latency and distinct reporting people per domain over the window, plus dispatch outcomes and the number of active trips.
tools.sql: SELECT d.domain AS domain, coalesce(m.calls, 0) AS calls, coalesce(m.errors, 0) AS errors, coalesce(m.slow, 0) AS slow, CASE WHEN coalesce(m.calls, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE m.latency_sum_ms / m.calls END AS avg_latency_ms, coalesce(m.people, 0) AS people, CASE d.domain WHEN 'dispatch' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch_requests x WHERE x.status = 'matched' AND x.updated_at >= :__now - (:window_min * 60000)) WHEN 'tracking' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips t WHERE t.status IN ('en_route', 'arrived')) ELSE NULL END AS gauge_a, CASE d.domain WHEN 'dispatch' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.status = 'no_driver' AND d.updated_at >= :__now - (:window_min * 60000)) WHEN 'tracking' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips t WHERE t.status IN ('en_route', 'arrived') AND (:__now - coalesce((SELECT l.updated_at FROM trip_locations l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id), (SELECT MAX(x.at) FROM trip_transitions x WHERE x.rider_id = t.rider_id AND x.trip_id = t.id AND x.to_status = 'en_route'), t.updated_at)) > 60000) ELSE NULL END AS gauge_b FROM (SELECT 'request' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'dispatch' UNION ALL SELECT 'tracking' UNION ALL SELECT 'notification' UNION ALL SELECT 'payment' UNION ALL SELECT 'maps' UNION ALL SELECT 'transition') d LEFT JOIN (SELECT domain, SUM(calls) AS calls, SUM(errors) AS errors, SUM(slow) AS slow, SUM(latency_sum_ms) AS latency_sum_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS people FROM client_metrics WHERE minute >= CAST(:__now - (:window_min * 60000) AS INTEGER) / 60000 GROUP BY domain) m ON m.domain = d.domain WHERE :__user_id IS NOT NULL

Each is a critical state-transition error to investigate. Empty means consistent.
tools.sql: SELECT i.rider_id AS ref, i.code, i.detail FROM (SELECT t.rider_id || '|' || t.id AS rider_id, 'completed_request_not_completed' AS code, r.status AS detail FROM trips t JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id WHERE t.status = 'completed' AND r.status != 'completed' UNION ALL SELECT t.rider_id || '|' || t.id AS rider_id, 'cancelled_request_still_open' AS code, r.status AS detail FROM trips t JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id WHERE t.status = 'cancelled' AND r.status IN ('open', 'matched') UNION ALL SELECT t.rider_id || '|' || t.id AS rider_id, 'active_trip_without_lock' AS code, 'no accepted offer' AS detail FROM trips t WHERE t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.rider_id = t.rider_id AND d.request_id = t.request_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_offers o WHERE o.rider_id = t.rider_id AND o.request_id = t.request_id AND o.status = 'accepted') UNION ALL SELECT t.rider_id || '|' || t.id AS rider_id, 'driver_locked_by_finished_trip' AS code, o.driver_id AS detail FROM dispatch_offers o JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = o.rider_id AND t.request_id = o.request_id WHERE o.status = 'accepted' AND t.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') UNION ALL SELECT d.rider_id || '|' || d.request_id || ':' || 'trip' AS rider_id, 'matched_without_trip' AS code, 'matched ' || (CAST(:__now - d.updated_at AS INTEGER) / 1000) || 's ago' AS detail FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.status = 'matched' AND d.updated_at < :__now - 120000 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.rider_id = d.rider_id AND t.request_id = d.request_id) UNION ALL SELECT d.rider_id || '|' || d.request_id || ':' || 'trip' AS rider_id, 'search_never_ended' AS code, 'deadline passed ' || (CAST(:__now - d.deadline_at AS INTEGER) / 1000) || 's ago' AS detail FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.status = 'searching' AND d.deadline_at < :__now - 120000 UNION ALL SELECT t.rider_id || '|' || t.id AS rider_id, 'trip_stuck_open' AS code, t.status || ' for ' || (CAST(:__now - t.updated_at AS INTEGER) / 60000) || ' min' AS detail FROM trips t WHERE t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') AND t.updated_at < :__now - 21600000 UNION ALL SELECT t.rider_id || '|' || t.id AS rider_id, 'finished_without_outcome' AS code, t.status AS detail FROM trips t JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id WHERE t.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND l.outcome IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.rider_id || '|' || t.id AS rider_id, 'finished_without_lifecycle' AS code, t.status AS detail FROM trips t WHERE t.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_requests d WHERE d.rider_id = t.rider_id AND d.request_id = t.request_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_lifecycle l WHERE l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id)) i WHERE :__user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.code, i.rider_id LIMIT :limit

tools.name: ops_health_errors
tools.description: Ops: structured errors reported by the app, grouped by domain, code and severity over the window, with how many people hit each, the latest time, and a sample trip. Never includes who.
tools.sql: SELECT e.domain, e.code, e.severity, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS people, MAX(e.at) AS last_at, MIN(e.trip_id) AS sample_trip, MIN(e.action) AS action, MAX(e.status) AS status FROM client_events e WHERE e.at >= :__now - (:window_min * 60000) AND (:domain IS NULL OR e.domain = :domain) AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.domain, e.code, e.severity ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: get_my_location_consents
tools.description: Any signed-in user: the caller's location consent record for each purpose (dispatch_availability: a driver's position while available for requests; trip_tracking: a driver's position during an assigned trip), the notice version agreed to and when it was granted or withdrawn.

tools.name: set_location_consent
tools.description: Any signed-in user: grant or withdraw consent to collect precise location for one purpose (dispatch_availability or trip_tracking), recording the notice version shown. Withdrawing erases what was collected under it straight away: dispatch_availability deletes the stored position, takes the driver offline and cancels open offers; trip_tracking deletes the driver's live trip positions. Invalid purposes or values change nothing.
statements: INSERT INTO location_consents (user_id, purpose, granted, notice_version, granted_at, withdrawn_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :purpose, :granted, :notice_version, CASE WHEN :granted = 1 THEN :__now END, CASE WHEN :granted = 0 THEN :__now END, :__now WHERE :purpose IN ('dispatch_availability', 'trip_tracking') AND :granted IN (0, 1) AND length(:notice_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 20 ON CONFLICT (user_id, purpose) DO UPDATE SET granted = excluded.granted, notice_version = excluded.notice_version, granted_at = CASE WHEN excluded.granted = 1 THEN excluded.updated_at ELSE location_consents.granted_at END, withdrawn_at = CASE WHEN excluded.granted = 0 THEN excluded.updated_at ELSE NULL END, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
UPDATE dispatch_offers SET status = 'cancelled', responded_at = :__now WHERE driver_id = :__user_id AND status = 'offered' AND :purpose = 'dispatch_availability' AND :granted = 0
UPDATE driver_availability SET available = 0, updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND :purpose = 'dispatch_availability' AND :granted = 0
DELETE FROM driver_locations WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND :purpose = 'dispatch_availability' AND :granted = 0
DELETE FROM trip_locations WHERE driver_id = :__user_id AND :purpose = 'trip_tracking' AND :granted = 0

tools.name: purge_expired_data
tools.description: Any signed-in user: delete data past its retention period, for everyone. Idempotent and safe to call often. Periods: live trip positions and driver dispatch positions 24 hours, trip evidence snapshots and safety report snapshots 30 days, notifications 30 days, diagnostic events and counters 14 days. Other data classes are kept until the account is deleted; see docs/privacy.md.
statements: DELETE FROM trip_locations WHERE updated_at < :__now - 86400000 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM driver_locations WHERE updated_at < :__now - 86400000 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM trip_evidence WHERE captured_at < :__now - 2592000000 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM notifications WHERE created_at < :__now - 2592000000 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM client_events WHERE at < :__now - 1209600000 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM client_metrics WHERE minute < CAST(:__now AS INTEGER) / 60000 - 20160 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM safety_report_snapshots WHERE captured_at < :__now - 2592000000 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL

tools.name: submit_safety_report
tools.description: Rider or the assigned driver: report a safety concern about the other person on a trip that is under way or ended within 7 days. Categories: emergency, assault, impaired (urgent) and unsafe_driving, harassment, discrimination, vehicle_mismatch, other (standard); the server sets the urgency, the reporter cannot lower it. Keeps the trip's phase, outcome, addresses, driver name, plate and the driver's last shared position (if any) as a snapshot for 30 days so staff can review it even after the live data is gone. Urgent reports also open a safety escalation. Standard reports are limited to 5 per hour per person; urgent ones are never limited. request_key makes retries safe. Anyone else, other categories and ended trips change nothing. Not a substitute for emergency services.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO safety_reports (id, rider_id, trip_id, reporter_id, reporter_role, subject_id, subject_role, category, urgency, note, trip_phase, trip_started_at, trip_ended_at, trip_outcome, vehicle_class, status, created_at) SELECT (:__user_id || ':' || :request_key), t.rider_id, t.id, :__user_id, CASE WHEN t.rider_id = :__user_id THEN 'rider' ELSE 'driver' END, CASE WHEN t.rider_id = :__user_id THEN d.user_id ELSE t.rider_id END, CASE WHEN t.rider_id = :__user_id THEN 'driver' ELSE 'rider' END, :category, CASE WHEN :category IN ('emergency', 'assault', 'impaired') THEN 'urgent' ELSE 'standard' END, substr(trim(coalesce(:note, '')), 1, 200), CASE WHEN t.status = 'arrived' AND l.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'in_progress' ELSE t.status END, l.started_at, l.ended_at, l.outcome, r.vehicle_class, 'open', :__now FROM trips t JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id LEFT JOIN trip_lifecycle l ON l.rider_id = t.rider_id AND l.trip_id = t.id LEFT JOIN assignments a ON a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON v.rider_id = a.rider_id AND v.id = a.vehicle_id WHERE t.rider_id = :rider_id AND t.id = :trip_id AND (t.rider_id = :__user_id OR d.user_id = :__user_id) AND (t.status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived') OR coalesce(l.ended_at, t.updated_at) >= :__now - 604800000) AND :category IN ('emergency', 'assault', 'impaired', 'unsafe_driving', 'harassment', 'discrimination', 'vehicle_mismatch', 'other') AND length(trim(coalesce(:request_key, ''))) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND (:category IN ('emergency', 'assault', 'impaired') OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety_reports x WHERE x.reporter_id = :__user_id AND x.created_at >= :__now - 3600000) < 5)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO safety_report_snapshots (report_id, rider_id, pickup_label, dropoff_label, driver_name, plate, lat, lng, accuracy_m, position_at, captured_at) SELECT s.id, s.rider_id, r.pickup_label, r.dropoff_label, d.display_name, v.plate, p.lat, p.lng, p.accuracy_m, p.updated_at, :__now FROM safety_reports s JOIN trips t ON t.rider_id = s.rider_id AND t.id = s.trip_id JOIN ride_requests r ON r.rider_id = t.rider_id AND r.id = t.request_id LEFT JOIN assignments a ON a.rider_id = t.rider_id AND a.id = t.assignment_id LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.rider_id = a.rider_id AND d.id = a.driver_id LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON v.rider_id = a.rider_id AND v.id = a.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN trip_locations p ON p.rider_id = t.rider_id AND p.trip_id = t.id WHERE s.id = (:__user_id || ':' || :request_key) AND s.reporter_id = :__user_id AND s.created_at = :__now

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO ops_escalations (id, rider_id, trip_id, driver_user_id, level, reason_code, note, status, opened_by, opened_at) SELECT 'safety:' || s.id, s.rider_id, s.trip_id, CASE WHEN s.subject_role = 'driver' THEN s.subject_id END, 'safety', 'safety', 'Urgent safety report (' || s.category || ') from the ' || s.reporter_role, 'open', s.reporter_id, s.created_at FROM safety_reports s WHERE s.id = (:__user_id || ':' || :request_key) AND s.reporter_id = :__user_id AND s.urgency = 'urgent' AND s.created_at = :__now

tools.name: list_my_safety_reports
tools.description: The caller's own safety reports (as a rider or a driver) with their status. Staff notes and the other person's id are not included. Part of the data export.
tools.sql: SELECT s.id, s.rider_id, s.trip_id, s.reporter_role, s.category, s.urgency, s.note, s.trip_phase, s.trip_started_at, s.trip_ended_at, s.trip_outcome, s.vehicle_class, s.status, s.created_at, s.resolved_at, s.resolution_code FROM safety_reports s WHERE s.reporter_id = :__user_id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: ops_list_safety_reports
tools.description: Ops: safety reports, urgent first then oldest first. Default is everything not yet resolved; pass a status (open, in_review, resolved) to filter. Redacted: no names, addresses, plates or coordinates (those need ops_pii and a logged reason via ops_get_safety_report_pii). Does not list reports where the caller is the reporter, the subject or the rider.
tools.sql: SELECT s.id, s.rider_id, s.trip_id, s.reporter_id, s.reporter_role, s.subject_id, s.subject_role, s.category, s.urgency, s.note, s.trip_phase, s.trip_started_at, s.trip_ended_at, s.trip_outcome, s.vehicle_class, s.status, s.created_at, s.acknowledged_by, s.acknowledged_at, s.resolved_by, s.resolved_at, s.resolution_code, s.resolution_note FROM safety_reports s WHERE s.rider_id != :__user_id AND s.reporter_id != :__user_id AND coalesce(s.subject_id, '') != :__user_id AND ((:status IS NULL AND s.status != 'resolved') OR s.status = :status) ORDER BY CASE s.urgency WHEN 'urgent' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.created_at LIMIT :limit

tools.name: ops_update_safety_report
tools.description: Ops: move a safety report forward. status in_review acknowledges an open report (records who and when; the acknowledgement time is what the urgent-report alert measures). status resolved closes it with a resolution code (no_action, warned, driver_suspended, rider_blocked, referred_externally, unable_to_substantiate, duplicate) and a mandatory note, and also resolves the linked safety escalation. Resolved reports cannot be reopened. Cannot act on reports where the caller is the reporter, the subject or the rider. Suspending a driver and blocking a rider are separate audited actions (ops_suspend_driver, ops_block_rider).
statements: UPDATE ops_escalations SET status = 'resolved', resolved_by = :__user_id, resolved_at = :__now, resolution_note = substr(trim(:note), 1, 200) WHERE id = 'safety:' || :report_id AND status = 'open' AND opened_by != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM safety_reports s WHERE s.id = :report_id AND s.rider_id != :__user_id AND s.reporter_id != :__user_id AND coalesce(s.subject_id, '') != :__user_id AND ((:status = 'in_review' AND s.status = 'open') OR (:status = 'resolved' AND s.status IN ('open', 'in_review') AND :resolution_code IN ('no_action', 'warned', 'driver_suspended', 'rider_blocked', 'referred_externally', 'unable_to_substantiate', 'duplicate') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0))) AND :status = 'resolved'

UPDATE safety_reports SET acknowledged_by = coalesce(acknowledged_by, :__user_id), acknowledged_at = coalesce(acknowledged_at, :__now), status = :status, resolved_by = CASE WHEN :status = 'resolved' THEN :__user_id END, resolved_at = CASE WHEN :status = 'resolved' THEN :__now END, resolution_code = CASE WHEN :status = 'resolved' THEN :resolution_code END, resolution_note = CASE WHEN :status = 'resolved' THEN substr(trim(:note), 1, 200) END WHERE id = :report_id AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM safety_reports s WHERE s.id = safety_reports.id AND s.id = :report_id AND s.rider_id != :__user_id AND s.reporter_id != :__user_id AND coalesce(s.subject_id, '') != :__user_id AND ((:status = 'in_review' AND s.status = 'open') OR (:status = 'resolved' AND s.status IN ('open', 'in_review') AND :resolution_code IN ('no_action', 'warned', 'driver_suspended', 'rider_blocked', 'referred_externally', 'unable_to_substantiate', 'duplicate') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0)))

tools.name: ops_get_safety_report_pii
tools.description: Ops (ops_pii): the personal details kept with a safety report: pickup and drop-off addresses, driver name and plate (needs a trip_pii access logged for the trip in the last 10 minutes) and the driver's last shared position with its time (needs an evidence access logged for the trip in the last 10 minutes; use ops_log_access with the report's rider_id and trip_id and reason safety_incident). Returns nothing without a logged access. Snapshots are erased 30 days after the report or when the rider deletes their account.
tools.sql: SELECT s.id AS report_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'trip_pii' AND g.rider_id = s.rider_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000) THEN p.pickup_label END AS pickup_label, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'trip_pii' AND g.rider_id = s.rider_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000) THEN p.dropoff_label END AS dropoff_label, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'trip_pii' AND g.rider_id = s.rider_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000) THEN p.driver_name END AS driver_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'trip_pii' AND g.rider_id = s.rider_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000) THEN p.plate END AS plate, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'evidence' AND g.rider_id = s.rider_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000) THEN p.lat END AS lat, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'evidence' AND g.rider_id = s.rider_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000) THEN p.lng END AS lng, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'evidence' AND g.rider_id = s.rider_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000) THEN p.accuracy_m END AS accuracy_m, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'evidence' AND g.rider_id = s.rider_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000) THEN p.position_at END AS position_at, p.captured_at FROM safety_reports s JOIN safety_report_snapshots p ON p.report_id = s.id WHERE s.id = :report_id AND s.rider_id != :__user_id AND s.reporter_id != :__user_id AND coalesce(s.subject_id, '') != :__user_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'trip_pii' AND g.rider_id = s.rider_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_access_log g WHERE g.actor_id = :__user_id AND g.scope = 'evidence' AND g.rider_id = s.rider_id AND g.trip_id = s.trip_id AND g.at > :__now - 600000))

tools.name: ops_block_rider
tools.description: Ops: block a rider from requesting rides, with a reason code (safety, abuse, fraud_suspected, other), a note and optionally the safety report that prompted it. Refused ride requests and quote acceptances from then on; withdraws their open driver offers and cancels any search in progress. A trip already under way is not touched; cancel it separately (ops_cancel_trip). The block survives account deletion so it cannot be dodged by recreating the account. Appended to the audit log; cannot block yourself; blocking an already blocked rider changes nothing.
statements: INSERT INTO rider_block_log (id, rider_id, action, reason_code, note, report_id, actor_id, at) SELECT :__uuid, :rider_user_id, 'blocked', :reason_code, substr(trim(:note), 1, 200), :report_id, :__user_id, :__now WHERE :rider_user_id != :__user_id AND length(trim(coalesce(:rider_user_id, ''))) > 0 AND :reason_code IN ('safety', 'abuse', 'fraud_suspected', 'other') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND NOT (coalesce((SELECT l.action FROM rider_block_log l WHERE l.rider_id = :rider_user_id ORDER BY l.at DESC, l.rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 'lifted') = 'blocked') AND (:report_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM safety_reports s WHERE s.id = :report_id))

UPDATE dispatch_offers SET status = 'cancelled', responded_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :rider_user_id AND status = 'offered' AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rider_block_log b WHERE b.id = :__uuid)

UPDATE dispatch_requests SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = :__now WHERE rider_id = :rider_user_id AND status = 'searching' AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rider_block_log b WHERE b.id = :__uuid)

tools.name: ops_lift_rider_block
tools.description: Ops: lift a rider block with a reason code (review_complete, appeal_upheld, error, other) and a note. Appended to the audit log; cannot lift your own; lifting a rider who is not blocked changes nothing.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO rider_block_log (id, rider_id, action, reason_code, note, report_id, actor_id, at) SELECT :__uuid, :rider_user_id, 'lifted', :reason_code, substr(trim(:note), 1, 200), NULL, :__user_id, :__now WHERE :rider_user_id != :__user_id AND :reason_code IN ('review_complete', 'appeal_upheld', 'error', 'other') AND length(trim(coalesce(:note, ''))) > 0 AND coalesce((SELECT l.action FROM rider_block_log l WHERE l.rider_id = :rider_user_id ORDER BY l.at DESC, l.rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 'lifted') = 'blocked'

tools.name: ops_list_rider_blocks
tools.description: Ops: riders who are blocked right now, newest first, with the reason, the note, the report that prompted it and who did it
tools.sql: SELECT l.rider_id, l.reason_code, l.note, l.report_id, l.actor_id, l.at FROM rider_block_log l WHERE l.action = 'blocked' AND l.rider_id != :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rider_block_log n WHERE n.rider_id = l.rider_id AND (n.at > l.at OR (n.at = l.at AND n.rowid > l.rowid))) ORDER BY l.at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_my_account_standing
tools.description: The caller's own standing: rider_blocked is 1 when operations have blocked them from requesting rides. Lets the app explain a refusal instead of failing silently.
tools.sql: SELECT coalesce((SELECT CASE l.action WHEN 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM rider_block_log l WHERE l.rider_id = :__user_id ORDER BY l.at DESC, l.rowid DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS rider_blocked
